Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['I have found you. I have been searching for you.', "Of course. Recreation is the refreshment of one's mind and body.", 'I am not a girl ... I am Aigis, and I am here.', 'He was asleep, so I unlocked the door.', 'I propose to be on standby in this room from now on. Is this acceptable?', 'If there is a problem, I will address it promptly.', 'I will do as commanded.', 'Canines do not have their own language. However, speech is not the only means of communication.', 'Confirmed.', 'According to my records, there is no structure in the area that matches those criteria. However, in the past there was an underground facility that was used by the military.', 'That is correct.', 'Understood.', 'We will be alright. Rather than wasting our energy, I suggest we deal with the Shadow first.', 'If I were to remain here on standby, it could delay our deployment. Therefore, I request to accompany our squad leader.', 'I will make any necessary adjustments as problems arise.', "I have a question, Minato-san. Why can't Koromaru-san attend school? I do not understand why I am permitted to go to school while Koromaru-san is not. Nowhere in the school regulations does it state that canines are prohibited from attending school.", 'Is there a problem?', "Perhaps it has something to do with the old power cables underground. They were just left there when the island's construction was completed.", 'Yes, they run underground in many directions, like a web.', 'There may still be a way to reach the structure that the cables feed into.', 'I suspect that you will be visiting Chidori-san. Although she has stabilized, we cannot release her.', 'This time, those two who call themselves Strega did not interfere.', 'There are indications that the window has been pried open.', 'It is surprising to find you on the rooftop.', 'I was asleep for much of the time, so I have not been in operation for very long.', 'I believe a celebration is in order.', 'Is this one of the open-air hot springs I have heard about?', 'To be honest, I am rather surprised by the difference between human bodies. More specifically ...', 'What was he doing here?', "But visitors aren't allowed here ...", "That's true ... I envy you, Junpei.", 'However, it is more accurate to say that I am "functioning" as opposed to living. There are times when I malfunction, but I can always be repaired.', 'A "living" weapon is difficult to operate ... however, I believe I understand the concept of loss. Should you ever be harmed, Minato, I ... you are very special to me. I do not know why, but I always want to be by your side. I want to protect you ...', "I am a machine ... I cannot die, so they won't have to grieve for me. I must do something ...", 'What are you doing here?', 'Have you forgotten?', 'The Dark Hour - a time period during which few people are active.', "Yes ... it's all so clear.", 'I am Aigis, the last remaining Anti-Shadow Emergency Control Weapon. A machine created to destroy Shadows.', "I'm a machine, so I can always be rebuilt. Even if I was completely destroyed, the programming data necessary to recreate me would still exist ...", "I'm sorry for all the trouble I've caused ... Mitsuru-san visited me at the lab and told me everything. That must have been difficult for you all to hear.", "I'm sorry. It's because I wasn't strong enough ... ten years ago, I ... what I did to you was ...", 'Ryoji has presented you with a difficult choice.', "I can't bear to see everyone hurting like this! Please choose to have your memories erased! Even if it means forgetting everything and everyone ...", '...', "My mission is to protect humanity from Shadows ... but now, I know that I can't defeat them! So then, why am I here?", "... but I can't fulfill that mission with the powers I was given. So then, what is my purpose now? Could someone please tell me?", 'Fuuka-san ...', "I don't know how I'll do it, but I guess that is a part of living, too.", 'Thank you! I will be with you all no matter what happens!', 'I have made my decision as well.', "Throughout history, those who have changed the future have often been highly charismatic ... that's the end of the article. It appears that after the interview, Takaya and Jin disappeared again.", "Takaya's words have changed the mood of the entire city. Even though they won't admit it, they are all afraid ...", "The fact that all life ends one day has nothing to do with Nyx. Death is a natural occurence in the cycle of life. Don't all humans realize this?", "I'm sorry I went off on my own ... it's nothing, really. I just needed some time to think.", "When I fought Ryoji, I got really scared when my consciousness began to fade. But that wasn't all ... I was also confused and embarrassed when I realized I couldn't defeat him ... but I couldn't defeat him ten years ago, either, and I didn't have those feelings then. I ... I really have changed.", 'You know, in the past if I didn\'t understand something, I would just ask someone to explain it to me. but since I\'ve decided to "live", no one\'s been able to answer the questions I\'ve been facing. However, there is one thing I\'ve come to understand ...', 'I still don\'t know what it means to "live" yet ...', "And I think I can if I'm with you, so please ... please take me with you! I may not be strong enough, but I'll fight with you to the end! Please!", 'I will not forget you, Yukari-san.', 'I will do my best.', 'It\'s not a matter of whether it is possible or not ... it\'s a matter of believing in ourselves. That\'s what it means to "live".', 'What do you mean?', "I'm so happy to see you again ... I'm sorry to show up so suddenly, but I really needed to talk to you."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["There's a lot going on.", "Yeah, right. It has to be THEM. Otherwise, it's not worth my time ...", "Don't worry. I'm just getting a little practice.", "Unfortunately, I don't have time to talk ... it's chasing me. I wanted to let you guys know. I'm almost there ...", "Get ready to be surprised ... It'll be here any second.", 'Like I had a choice!', "Normal people don't realize it, since they're all sleeping inside their coffins. But that's not what makes the Dark Hour so interesting. ... You saw those creatures.", "They only appear during the Dark Hour, and attack anyone not in a coffin. It's our job to defeat them. ... Sounds exciting, huh?", "There's someone I wanna introduce. ... Hey, hurry up!", "This is Junpei Iori from Class 2-F. He'll be staying here as of today.", 'I bumped into him the other night. He has the Potential, but he just awakened to it recently. I told him about us, and he agreed to help.', "I think we're about ready ...", 'With this many people, we can start exploring that place.', 'We believe we can find the reason for the Dark Hour there.', 'The Chairman will give us the details tomorrow night, so be ready.', "Just like the Shadows ... interesting, huh? And it's the perfect place for us to train.", '... Yeah, I know.', "Well, maybe now we'll find out. Mitsuru and I have only gone in to take a peek ... this will be our first time exploring it. Exciting, isn't it? There has to be some kind of clue in here about the Dark Hour ...", "I know ... you don't have to remind me.", "First, we'll have you three get a feel for the place. Why don't you go have a look around?", "That's right.", "That's true, but there's another reason.", "These are Shadows we're talking about here. Without your Persona, you're toast.", "Heh. We'll see about that.", '...', "I want the two of you to meet me at Paulownia Mall. You know where it is, right? I'll be at the police station. See ya there.", "Who, these girls? I don't even know their names. They talk so much they give me a headache. Anyway, I'm gonna head out ... don't keep me waiting.", 'Oh, these are the guys I was talking about earlier.', 'I was waiting for you guys. This is Officer Kurosawa. He helps keep our squad well-equipped. And this is from Ikutsuki-san ...', 'Officer Kurosawa has connections ... but these things still cost money.', "I realize that. Well, I'll see you later. Thanks again.", "I'm just here for a checkup.", 'A friend from school, sort of. You know how the number of Apathy Syndrome cases has been increasing? Well, he knows a few people who are suffering from it, so I was asking him about it. Hey Junpei, did you bring what I asked?', "It's nothing. I've wasted enough time already ... I need to get back to my training.", "You mean, why did I choose that sport? Well ... it's not the sport itself I like. I just wanted to learn how to fight. I know what it's like to feel powerless ... and I don't want to feel that way again. Besides, I'm curious to see how strong I can get. It's like a game, only I'm competing against myself.", "You're referring to the shadows, I take it?", 'True ... lately, it seems like the Lost are everywhere. So something must be going on ...', "How's it going? Have you been training in Tartarus? It never hurts to train while you have the chance. My wounds will heal in no time, and then I'll be able to join you on the front line. But don't just rely on me.", "But I thought you couldn't scan outside of Tartarus?", "I have to admit, I was surprised too. But in the end, it's up to him whether or not he can reach his full potential.", 'What? You actually found one?!', "Well then, this is gonna be fun. I'll wake up the others.", "What?! Are you kidding? I'm going!", 'Tch ...', '... Dammit.', "You should let the three of them go first. If you're providing backup out there, you'll need time to get ready, right?", 'But what are the Shadows up to? Taking over a monorail ... this is getting out of hand.', "Huh ... ? Why do you look so tired, Ikutsuki-san? Wait ... don't tell me that bicycle outside is yours!", "Hm, looks like my grades went up. Well, I guess that makes sense, since I've been spending all my time studying.", "Hey, let's go to Tartarus later. I need to get back into the swing of things. I can't leave all the fun to you guys.", "I'm interested. Go ahead and tell us.", "I think it's worth investigating.", "Then I'll let you guys handle it. Just make sure you sleep with one eye open ...", "This is only a theory, but I think time may function differently with respect to Tartarus. So even though it's been ten days for us, perhaps only ten hours have passed for her. It's possible she's still alive.", "I have an idea ... let's try to enter Tartarus exactly how Fuuka did. We'll go to the gym and wait for midnight. That's the quickest way.", "I won't stand by and do nothing if there's a chance we can save her. I'd never forgive myself.", "We don't have time to waste. Let's go.", "No time for compliments ... let's go.", "Quiet. It's better if we leave 'em off. They cut the power at night anyway.", '... Maybe I should go to the Faculty Office too. It sounds interesting.', 'Come on, Mitsuru. Lighten up a little ...', 'Keep it down!', 'You should come, too, Minato. You can take the lead like always.', "Alright, Junpei, we'll give you another shot.", "I don't think we should enter Tartarus this way again ...", "I'm glad you're okay ... come with us.", "Looks like we made the right decision. I'll contact Mitsuru.", 'Mitsuru, can you hear me? ... no good, all I hear is static.', "Are you serious? How's that possible?", "... Maybe even stronger, since Mitsuru's Persona is more battle-oriented ...", "Think of it as a lucky charm. It's not really a gun. Alright, let's get outta here!", 'Some research indicates that the Shadows are affected by the phases of the moon. Of course, the same can be said for humans.', 'Hey, did you see the moon the night the dorm was attacked, back in April?', 'Mitsuru, can you hear me?! Come in!', 'Mitsuru? Mitsuru!', "Don't worry, it's over.", 'Where did those two Shadows come from?', 'I see ...', "The good news is she didn't fall victim to the Shadows, even though she obviously heard their call. She should be safe from now on.", "It's a big advantage to know when to expect them. Now, on the day of the fight we'll be ready to get in the ring.", "This is interesting, but no matter what, we still have to beat the rest of 'em.", "We'll manage. We've got plenty of time.", 'Hmph ...', "We've got four new members. Things have changed quite a bit since you left. We're more aggressive now.", "Think about it, Shinji. Don't let your power go to waste.", 'Shinji!', "You have to let the past go. What's done is done. It's time you moved on.", 'What?!', "Alright, then I'll let you decide on the rest of the team. Let's do this.", "I'm surprised there was another Shadow ... anyway, are you alright?", "Alright, let's call it a night.", "Ikutsuki-san is coming tonight. He has something to tell us. We'll meet on the 4th floor as soon as everyone gets back.", 'I have my reasons ...', "Mitsuru ... don't.", 'Then if we defeat them all, Tartarus and the Dark Hour will disappear ... ?', "... It's nothing like that. I just wanted to see how you were doing.", "It's been almost 14 years since we met at the orphanage ... you, me, and Miki ... we used to run around here until the sun went down. Back then, it seemed like we had all the time in the world.", 'What was that?!', "... I do reminisce sometimes, but what's the point?", "To be honest, all I've been thinking about lately is getting stronger. But yesterday, someone made me question my reason for fighting ...", "I'm not like you. ... Man, I can't believe I'm the one getting lectured here.", 'Hmm, the beach ... I should design a special training regimen.', 'Ikutsuki-san called me. I think he wants to talk about a new candidate.', 'Maybe ...', 'You know him ... ?', "Then he's the new candidate ... ?", '...', 'Um ... yeah.', "Yeah, well ... it's nice to meet you ...", "Don't be stupid ...", "Darn ... there's nothing out there I can use as a marker ... too bad. I was hoping for a good swim.", "What's wrong with that? You got a better idea?", 'Y-you okay?', "It looks like Fuuka's handwriting ...", 'Well, it is your fault ...', "I don't want to hear it.", 'You mean, like, pick up girls ... ?', 'I thought you said you were an expert ...', "Well, we were invited to our friend's vacation home ... pretty cool, huh?", 'Wh-why should I?', '...', "Fine, I'll give it a shot. I'm sure I'll do better than you. Can you give me a hand, Minato? I'll set the pace, of course.", '... just keep your mouth shut.', "That's my cue.", 'Um ... are you here alone?', 'N-no, not at all ...', "I'll be graduating next year.", 'Well, that might be interesting ...', 'Uh, n-no thanks.', '...', 'Do you have to say it like that?', "If I'm in a match, I want to win. I know what our problem is ... you can't control yourself.", "I'm just stating the obvious.", 'What did you just say ... ?', 'I agree ...', 'Sounds like a good plan.', "Heh ... don't worry about me.", "Oh, um, yeah, I like the ocean too. Hey, I heard that triathletes who train at the beach perform better than those who practiice indoors. Makes sense, doesn't it?", "We're on the ropes, but it's not over yet ... it's all up to you now.", 'This is unbelievable ...', 'We were all up late last night ...', "Okay, I'll let everyone know.", "No, the Shadow's been defeated.", 'He defeated that Shadow all by himself.', "Well, you better win. Watch out for Mamoru, though. He's a tough competitor.", "Yeah, next Thursday, the 6th. Make sure you're ready.", "Now that's more like it.", 'Agreed.', '...', "You know, another new Persona-user joined us ... and he's not human.", "It's a dog. He lost his master six months ago because of the Shadows. He's incredibly loyal ... up 'til now, he's been guarding the spot where his master was killed despite the bad memories.", "But it's been two years since then ...", "How long do you plan to beat yourself up over it? You're always at that spot behind the station, even though you don't hang out with the crowd there.", 'Shinji ...', 'You must be kidding ...', 'But is HE okay with it?', '...', "I have something important to take care of after school. I want you to come. I'll be waiting by the gate, so meet me there.", "There's something I have to do, and I want you to come with me. We're going to get someone. ... An old member.", "We have a new enemy. They're Persona-users, like us.", "There's more. Ken Amada has joined our team.", "He has the Potential, and Ikutsuki-san has okayed it. He's now a Persona-user.", 'Yeah. He volunteered.', 'Is that its power?', 'Hey, is she okay?', "And they're interfering with her ability?", '... Now it all makes sense.', 'Even if we know where it is, we might not be able to get to it ...', "Yukari, call a nurse. We're done for today. I'll inform Ikutsuki-san of the difficulties we're having.", 'I thought I had removed all the sharp objects in here ...', "Well, that's a start. So why are YOU here?", "Why did you have those pills?! I've heard about those ... they're taken to suppress a Persona when the user can't control it. But the side-effects ... you're not taking them, are you?", 'Answer me!', 'Tch ... the same as always.', 'You know the reason ...', "That's why I try so hard ... we promised, remember? To become strong enough to do what we think is right ... so why the drugs? Why didn't you come talk to me?", '... and the side effects?', 'Like what?', 'Same here. This stupid typhoon is gonna mess up my training.', "Where's Shinji?", "Figures. he's always played by his own rules.", 'Dammit, Shinji ... where are you?', '...', "I had the usual for lunch ... ramen tastes a lot better when you're cutting class. Make sure you invite me next time ...", "Why are you always like that? You're so stubborn. Put yourself in my shoes for a change ...", "I guess you're right ... I was too obsessed with power ... ever since I lost Miki, that's all I've cared about. I thought that if I was strong enough, I could protect anyone ...", "But I was so focused on fighting that I didn't notice anything else! It didn't matter how tough I was! Look what happened!", "... yeah, I know ... crying won't change anything, will it? Alright, Shinji ...", 'Shinji\'s last words were, "This is how it should be." He was a hell of a guy ... he even faced death head on. That\'s why, from this day forward, I\'ll face things head on too.', "Let Ken do what he wants. Bringing him back won't change anything, and we can't keep treating him like a kid.", "It's his choice. He's the only one who can decide how he's going to live his life. The same goes for all of us ...", "The dead are never coming back. You have to accept that. You're on your own now ...", "I'm not here to drag you back. You can stay in this place until you die, if that's what you want.", "Well, it's all been worth it if you ask me. It's been two and a half years since I got this power and you don't hear me complaining.", "It would've happened to someone eventually ... besides, the enemy can't just be ignored.", 'Hmph. Saves us the trouble of looking for them.', 'So it was you who was giving Shinji those pills.', "They chose their own fate. Don't let it phase you.", "Sushi, huh? It's been awhile ... well, I've got dibs on the halibut and sea urchin!", "He took her to the lab for a tune-up or something. He said they'll join us later.", 'Apparently, I was right to have my doubts.', '... Mitsuru.', "That's why we fought so hard! But now ...", 'What are you talking about?!', "Yeah, it's never the truth.", "I'm sure she'll be busy for at least a week.", "No word yet. They're probably too busy to be thinking about that. In fact, the entire Kirijo Group must be in a state of shock.", "True, but there is one thing we know ... Tartarus is still around, and there's a bunch of Shadows inside it. We should train, so we're ready for whatever it is we have to face.", "It's probably just a guy.", 'Shh! Yeah, I know! Now keep your voice down.', 'How many are there, Yamagishi?', "Get back, Junpei! It's useless trying to reason with her!", 'He was ... ?', 'You mean, everyone will die?!', "No ... but I don't plan on running away.", 'What about you? What are your thoughts on it?', "Yeah, we're all scared.", 'Is this where you should be?', "Yeah, same here. I don't have anything I need to tell Shinji right now. ... I have my own stuff to deal with.", '... You got me.', 'No need to ask me.', "Personally, I don't care if it is impossible.", "No, I don't believe in superstitions.", 'Hold it right there, Junpei.', "You're going to the shrine, aren't you?", "Oh yeah? Well I'm going with you, then. I'm bored.", 'Hey, why do I have to treat everyone?', "Alright, alright! I never said I wouldn't.", "I don't think he really means what he's saying. This is all just a game to him.", "Well, Jin's pretty well-known on the Internet ... he's probably pretty good at stirring up trouble.", "Well, there's only one place they could've gone - Tartarus. They must've been planning this all along.", 'I guess people just need something to believe in.', "I agree. We'll probably run into them at Tartarus anyway ... however you look at it, we're the obstacle standing in their way.", "Yeah, so don't worry about it.", 'Yeah, it should be a special day ...', '... This is going to be easy.', "Where's your partner?", 'Why are you so loyal to him?', "Sorry ... but we're not gonna let that happen!"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["Haha, no. I'm kidding. You're so easy, Maiko.", 'So you\'re the guy she was talking about. I wondered what you were like ... are you "too old" to play with kids, or are you still young at heart?', "Nah, I'm okay, thanks. I'll see you guys around.", "The me that I see reflected in your eyes and the real me, if there is such a thing ... how far apart are they? Your words are very beautiful ... if I had something to write with, I'd write them down.", 'My pen is my supporter, my spokesman, and my friend. However, it seems to have disappeared. Without it, my screams are silenced.', 'Ah ... welcome home, dear friend. ... Thank you for finding it for me.', "Have a seat if you'd like. I'll write something for the two of us.", 'She was very ... bright. Her face shone with the warm light of life.', "Misery is a harsh mistress. I feel as though I'm lying in an unyielding darkness. Can you understand how I feel?", '...', "Unless you're in my situation, you can't understand what it's like. But I prefer it that way. I wouldn't wish this on anyone. There isn't anything you can do to slow this down or make things better.", "I haven't spoken to someone my own age in a long time. ... It's natural for those in darkness to yearn for the world of light.", 'I would rather you not come here ever again. You only live once, right? Why waste your life among the dying?', "I didn't expect to see you again. Usually people don't come back. Nobody treats me like a normal guy ... not even my family. I can tell by how they look at me. The pity in their eyes is unmistakable. I don't need their sympathy any more than I need their curiosity.", "I don't expect anyone to pity me.", "... Hey. Thanks for coming today. You don't seem like everyone else. I'm not sure I know how to describe it exactly, but ... you don't look down on me the way everyone else does.", 'Dammit ... what did I do to deserve this body?', "Thank you for coming ... it's better when I'm not alone. Why do I have to face this alone? ... Other people don't have to deal with this sickness.", '... But so what? That has nothing to do with my plight here in this bed. Where is there meaning in any of this?!', "I wish I could run away ... but if my body was capable of that, I wouldn't be here anyway. No matter what I do, my body is there to remind me ... I'm going to die.", "Please don't leave ... just yet ... when I'm alone it feels like it could end at any second.", "I know it probably looked pretty bad last time, right? ... I had been reading a book before you came that day. I got so absorbed in the reading that I forgot to close the window, and I didn't realize how chilly it was.", "I read a lot of books these days. I find that they're the easiest ways to spend my time, since I can get lost in a book's private world. Do you read books all the way to the end? I really get into the story and usually reach the end quickly, but ... I never want to finish it.", "Stories about hope or heroism ... those're the kinds of books I read. So hopefully, if I do decide to finish reading them, I'll feel happy at the end when I come back here.", "I thought I'd be fine since I have many nights when I'm unable to sleep because of my illness, but ... I guess my condition won't improve if I keep taking chances. I came all this way because I was hoping to find you ... remember how I talked about reading upbeat stories?", "The problem is, all those stories were written for someone else. I guess what I'm saying is selfish, but I'm being selfish about you, too. You're always coming to see me, and I take up a lot of your time ... how much of your valuable time have you used on visiting me?", "He was born in the calm forest of green, but he turned out to be pink. He's so visible that he can't hunt for food easily, so he's always especially hungry. The other animals dislike him and consider his coloration disgusting, almost like he's cursed. So he started living alone, but then he made a friend.", "So the bird would stand on the pink alligator's back and practice its flying. It's embarassing to talk about, but I'm writing it for myself, so that's what matters. Maybe I'll be able to show you the entire novel someday.", "I wanted to write an upbeat story of my own to cheer me up. Maybe if I can find some meaning to life, I can put that in my story. When I write ... I can see you in my mind. It seems as if you're telling me not to die just yet ...", "This was the alligator's first friend, and he was very happy. They started going to the river every day, and the little bird would sing while the alligator listened. But again, the alligator couldn't catch food easily because of his color. Pink is such an odd color, his prey in the jungle saw him from far away and had plenty of time to escape. He became so hungry that he was dizzy most of the time ... and he accidentally ate the bird one afternoon as it slept in his mouth.", "He drank swamp water to induce vomiting, but the bird was already dead when he retrieved it. After that, he couldn't bring himself to eat anything. That's as far as I've written. I haven't decided on an ending.", "That was a lie. I was writing my will. I couldn't face reality, and I was essentially screaming curses into my notebook. But for now, I'm writing my story in the same notebook.", "When it's done, I want you to read it. I mean, meeting you is the main reason I started writing it.", "It's calming down. Thanks.", "I know, I know ... it's only speeding things along, but ... my medicine makes me drowsy, and if my hands go numb, then I can't write anything. I have to finish my story.", "I get lost in my writing ... erase it ... and then don't know where to go next. When we're talking, I have a clearer picture. I can almost see it ... it seems like that might be the meaning of life for me.", 'Well, if I do find it and finish the story, I hope we get a little more time together after that.', "So much for the hospital, right? Now I'm just waiting for the end, but I don't feel like I'm the only one being singled out anymore.", "But once the time comes, it's the same for us all. I'm still a little lonely, but I'm not sad anymore.", "I've been waiting. I finished my story and wanted to show it to you. As you know, I was having a lot of trouble with the ending, but I finally figured it out. Since the alligator ate his friend the bird, he cried and cried for a very long time. In fact, he was so sad that he drowned in his own tears.", 'The other animals in the forest came there often to relax, but none of them knew the alligator had created it or that he was gone. The end.', "Even though the alligator did not find meaning in his life, the residents of the forest did. They just didn't realize it.", "It's really what others think of my life or what I was able to do for them.", "People can't survive without help from others. We all depend on one another.", 'Coming to see me, talking ... even discussing the meaning of life ... I ... I can be glad that I was born ...']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["Aren't you ze transfer student everyone eez talking about? I go to zee same school - Gekkoukan! I came 'ere from France to study abroad. My name eez Andre Laurent Jean Geraux.", 'Hajime mashite, it eez nice to meet you!', "I 'ope to see you zere. Sayonara, goodbye!", "I 'aven't seen you since ze bookstore! You came! I am very 'appy!", 'Zis eez tanoshii, very fun! Would you like to try?', "Arigatou, thank you! I was sad because I did not 'ave any tomodachi -- friends -- when I came to Nihon -- Japan ... but now I am 'appy!", "Let's go to ze Sweet Shop, Minato-sama ... zis is my first time going, so will you teach me?", "I am so 'appy, ureshii! I love ze culture of Nihon! Japan eez sugoi, amazing! My country is nozing compared to Nihon. Japan eez number 1, ichiban! I wish I was born 'ere.", "I 'ave an aunt who lives back 'ome ... she 'as been 'elping me ... I must tell 'er zat I 'ave made a great friend! Tomodachi!", "I 'ave to get better too! I am glad to 'ave such a great friend - tomodachi - as my rival! Minato-sama ... I would like to make somezing Japanese, but what?", "It 'as to be a kimono! But ... zat is very 'ard to make ... I don't know 'ow. Plus, it eez expensive ... hmm. I will zink about it. Arigatou! Zank you for ze advice!", "Speaking of Japanese music ... I love ze sound of zee crickets. It eez very soothing ... 'ow about you, Minato-sama? Do you like ze sound of ze crickets?", 'I would like for my aunt to hear them chirp ...', 'Uh ... last night ... my dear aunt ... was taken away by ze angels!', "S-sorry, gomenasai ... she was ze reason I was able to come to Japan ... and now, she 'as been taken away ... she 'elped me so much, and I could not do anything for 'er ... I was 'olding zis inside ... because I know zat crying will not 'elp ...", "Sorry, gomenasai. I can't work today. Sayonara ...", "I was able to come 'ere because of my aunt, but ... my uncle did not agree wiz ze decision! He eez yelling at me to come 'ome now, like ze mafia. Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["Hey, you're a student, aren't you? You must be from Gekkoukan High, right? That means you've probably seen the persimmon tree there ... do you think I'm making this up?! I'm serious! It was planted right beside a walkway in a courtyard at the school.", 'I knew it! I knew right from the start that you\'re a kind young man! I\'ve been meaning to go see that tree for a while now, but I\'m not sure if these stumpy old legs will make it that far. ... That wasn\'t supposed to be a pun, you know. "Stumpy", "tree stump" ... catch my drift?', "So, your name is Minako Arisato ... then, we'll call you Minako-chan from now on!", "What was your name again? I'm just joking, I know who you are. I'm not that old. My wife and I were just talking about you, Minato-chan.", 'What was your name again?', 'He should be here helping customers ... I\'m sorry, Minato-chan. I\'m sure he\'d rather be "hanging out" with his friends than taking care of an old man like me. I\'m sure he\'ll be back soon. Right, dear?', "But I can't seem to find it ...", "Minato-chan? How'd you know I was looking for something? Are you psychic? I'm looking for my glasses ... no, not my glasses, my wallet. I can't seem to find it.", "I was just thinking it'd be nice if someone gave us a hand.", 'Wait, what were we looking for?', "Wow! This is it! I've been looking for this wallet everywhere! Well, it's not a golden wallet, but I'm still happy to have it back!", "Hmm ... I thought I put it in my wallet so I wouldn't lose it ... ah, here it is! I knew it was in here!", "Come on dear, you know what it is. It's the key for our son's car. Seeing Minato-chan reminded me of how things used to be. I haven't heard the roar of the engine in a long time. How do I look, dear?", "Minato-chan, please punch me ... punch me for being so insensitive. With all my excitement, I forgot to consider how my wife might feel. I'm such a ... such a ...", "My wife just left for Gekkoukan. Well, she won't be gone long. Why don't you keep me company, Minato-chan?", "... Wait, where are the cups? I'm afraid I'm completely useless without my wife.", 'My wife heard a rumor that it was going to be cut down, and she almost fainted. Do you know anything about it, Minato-chan?', "I'm sorry for troubling you about the persimmon tree ... it's a reminder of our son. Before his death, he was a teacher at Gekkoukan High School. He planted that tree on graduation day with the students in his first class.", "Wow, Minato-chan, you've really captured her heart! You must be popular with the ladies! My wife's no sucker, after all! I feel I'm looking at myself when I was in my prime!", "So we went to the school to say goodbye, but that just reminded Mitsuko of our son's death ...", 'If you keep crying all the time, then what will your admirers think? Right, Minato-chan?', "She always cries at happy events, like the day we first met! All the graduates from my son's class have gathered at the school. They're collecting signiatures to save the persimmon tree!", "It's been so many years, but they still remember him ...", 'Minato-chan, were you the one who called them all?', 'From the first time I saw you, Minato-chan, I knew you were different from the kids around here. You "da man", Minato-chan! Incredible ...', "Someday, I'd like to go have a drink together ... but let's wait until you're legal.", 'Yeah, I wish! Actually, it was one of the organizers of the campaign to save the persimmon tree. He said "Let\'s protect the tree together!" AND he\'s gotten a lot of signatures from students who were in our son\'s class.', 'Of course! He was our proud son!', "Alright! Minato-chan, let's go to Gekkoukan right now! I have to tell my son the good news! I've never been so excited about a walk before!", 'I know, I know! I just forgot to write down the second one.', "Oh, speak of the devil! I'm writing a letter ... something I haven't done in ages. But I can't remember how to spell half these words! Am I finally losing it? I used to have an amazing vocabulary.", "Well, aren't you curious?", 'Lately, I even feel smarter! Maybe I should go back to school ... just kidding!', 'Or were you just eager to see my pretty face?', "Even though it's the middle of the day, I feel so sleepy ... well, since Mitsuko is here too, I think it's time we told you.", "Sorry that we did it without asking you. Recently, I went to visit the persimmon tree, and I met a student on the way back. He told me that the school is planning to build a new addition. It would be selfish of an old man like me to deprive those young people of new learning opportunities ... I think it'd make our son happy, too, since he was a teacher. Helping those kids is more important than hanging in to his memory.", "We're hoping, as we believe our son in Heaven is too, that more kind students like you will graduate from Gekkoukan. ... Please take this.", "Our son would want us to be happy ... I'm sure he's smiling down on us from Heaven."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["I'm sorry ...", "I-I get really nervous when I, um, talk to people ... especially boys ... I know it's bad, but I can't help it ...", "Sorry, I won't be a very good Student Council representative if I'm like this ... I have to try harder to overcome this phobia. I'll do my best ...", "I was able to say hi to you! I've been telling myself not to be afraid, but the more I think about it, the more scared I get ... I hope I can somehow get better at this ...", "I was so busy searching through the books ... I'm sorry if I ignored you, Minato-san. Uh, I'm sorry it took so long ... this place has so many interesting books, I was having trouble deciding.", "I tend to get frustrated when the main character can't ask out the guy she likes, because I can relate to her ... oh, I'm sorry! This probably isn't the best place to talk. We may be disturbing other patrons.", "T-today, I was able to be myself with you, Minato-san. That's a big step for me ... thank you.", "I was chosen for this job without my consent ... I never asked to be Treasurer ... b-but if I didn't join Student Council, I never would've met you, right?!", "I'm sorry ...", 'Wh-where do they think they are?!', "I say this as a member of Student Council ... that kind of behavior shouldn't be tolerated at school! Let's discuss this in our next meeting! If you're on my side, Minato-san, then I have nothing to fear!", '... and that teacher wants us to look for the one who did it ...', "I may have caught a cold ... I'm sorry, Minato-san, but can we go to a drug store?", 'Wh-what do you want?', 'L-leave me alone! Go away! Minato-san ...', "I-I'm glad. I thought you were going to hit him, Minato-san ... I-I wouldn't want you to fight because of me, but just now you were ... um ... you helped me, Minato-san, and I'm not scared anymore, b-but ... why am I still shaking?", "Thank you ... I'm okay now.", 'Minato-san, I ...', "Oh my, is there red bean jam on my face ... ? ... Remember when you saved me from that creep, Minato-san? From that day on, my health hasn't been so great ... the doctor said I'm fine, but ... I guess I'll tell you, Minato-san, since you've been so nice to me! B-but don't think I'm weird, okay?!", "I dream about you every night ... this has never happened to me before. I appreciate how nice you've been to me, Minato-san ...", "I get so nervous when I'm around you, Minato-san ... especially when you look at me that way ... sorry ...", "So far, I can only talk to boys I know, but ... I can almost look them in the eye! With your help, Minato-san, I feel like I can do even better! As long as it's nothing scary ... I'll be fine!", 'Sorry about that ... um ... your coffee is going to get cold.', "Shall we get going? I don't see anything that interests me ...", "I've been dying to read this! This is a collection of illustrations from the shojo manga I read! It even has short stories inside! I would never have expected this to be here ... maybe the shop owner made a mistake.", "Each volume is 6,000 yen, so that means ... 18,000 yen total? My weekly allowance is 5,000 yen, and even if I used my lunch money ... but I'll get them no matter what! By next month ... wait, by the time I graduate!", "Until recently ... but I sort of understand how he feels. That man ... he doesn't have any self-confidence, so he tries to compensate with his money ... but I can understand how he must feel, trying to hold onto something no matter what the cost.", 'In the manga that the artist of that book draws, the main character is always a shy girl ... her admiration of the boy she likes drives her to become more confident and charming. I want to be like that too ...', 'Oh, that money ... I gave it to the teacher in the office ...', 'Huh? I just told you ...', "You agree with me, right, Minato-san? It's NOT my fault! I-I gave the money to the teacher! It's not my fault, so why should I have to apologize?", 'Wait! You think I ... ? N-nevermind.', "I-I couldn't stand up to them, but I didn't take anything! I have to prove to everyone that it wasn't me, so what should I do? I never expected this to happen ... Minato-san, what should I do ... ?", "I can't take this anymore ... I ... don't want to be here ... s-sorry! I shouldn't be saying things like this as a member of Student Council! I'm going to go check out some books ...", "The only time I feel safe is when I'm with you, Minato-san ... I have no one else to turn to in school. Do you think I should just wait it out, Minato-san? I know you're probably right, but ... when will the rumors stop?! Will everyone just assume I'm guilty?!", "I don't think it's right for me to always be counting on you, Minato-san ...", 'You think I stole the money ...', 'Th-thank you, Ms. President ...', 'You had a bandage on your chin because you cut yourself while shaving! I handed the fee money to you directly! Do you expect me to just pretend that never happened?!', 'Please explain! Or else ... or else someone important to me will ...', 'What?!', "It's not funny!", 'Hahaha ... remember what I said to Mitsuru-san? "Get away from him!" I-I was worried what might happen if you and Mitsuru-san were alone together ... I was so flustered I almost passed out. I\'m pretty weird, huh? I\'ve been like that ever since I was a kid, or so my mother says. Normally, I\'m quiet and timid, but when it comes to something I care about then I become aggressive.']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["March 6th, 2000. To my family: Tomorrow, I'll bring this letter to the opening ceremony for the Moonlight Bridge. It'll be stored in a time capsule, and sent to you ten years from now. Yukari ... you're so small right now, but in ten years you'll be sixteen. You'll be in high school.", "I know you've been sad because I have to work so late, but you still always greet me with a smile. I'm really proud of myself. Kirijo-san appointed me Head Researcher. I'll be starting on a big project soon, and I'm happy to be recieving so much recognition for my work ... but I swear to you that nothing is more important to me than you and your mother. Yukari ... are you remembering to enjoy life? Are you still bright-eyed and hopeful like you are now? No matter what happens in the next ten years, I hope you're happy.", 'I pray that this recording reaches safe hands ...', "This experiment should have never even been conceived ... I'm afraid what I've done will result in an unprecedented disaster, but if I hadn't, the entire world may have paid the price.", 'Please, listen carefully ... the Shadows that were amassed here have been dispersed as a result of the explosion.', "I am to blame for this. I knew the risks, but I was blinded by the promise of success, and so I didn't raise any objections ... it is all my fault.", "This experiment should never have been conceived ... that's why I had to interrupt it. However, in doing so, I set free a number of Shadows that are certain to torment future generations. If I hadn't, the entire world may have paid the price ... please, listen carefully ...", "I wasn't able to stop this madness. He won't listen, no matter what I say ... he's under the devil's spell. Now the Shadows are trying to eat one another ... but if they're reunited, then we are all doomed!", "There's not much hope for me now. I have just one favor to ask. Whoever finds this ... please ... give my daughter Yukari this message ..."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['There is a matter we need to discuss.', "I have a big favor to ask. I have been looking for someone with exceptional strength. It's been quite some time since we've had a visitor worthy of our attention. If you don't mind, will you accept my requests?", 'You may register any of your Personas into this book, and for a fee, you can withdraw them at any time.', "However, you are already moving towards another truth. Although memories may remind you of the past, always walk toward the future ... I must admit, I'm a bit envious, since I have neither."]

I'm scared too.", 'What are you doing here?', "Is that Chidori's sketchbook?", "Oh, I went home for a bit. I've been going back there a lot lately.", 'Really ... ?', "You've changed too, Junpei-kun.", "That's not true.", "You're scared because you're not running away ... that's nothing to be ashamed of.", "That's why I want to protect everyone ...", '... and I want to be true to myself.', 'Me too. I was fearing the worst ...', "When I saw you collapse, I realized something. I want to protect you ... I don't want to forget about you.", "I'm with the rest of you.", "I won't forget you, either!", "I don't think it should be the dorm ... we'll come back here anyways if all goes well. Hey, shouldn't we also decide on when we'll meet?", '... Together.', 'Who are you?!', "That's just because all these weird things have been happening!", "That can't be!"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["Some students feel the school uniform should be abolished and they're recruiting supporters ...", "They think life without rules is freedom. It's ridiculous, plain and simple. Without rules, the whole system will collapse. They're mistaking selfishness for freedom. ... Sorry, I may have overreacted. I hate people with no common sense. Sometimes I can't believe the things that come out of their mouths.", 'He just wants to help create a better school environment, so he offered to help us. Just like how the President asked Minato-kun to join Student Council.', "Look, you ahve two choies. Either help out and prove you're trustworthy, or refuse and raise suspicion. We sure have to deal with a lot of BS around here, don't we Minato-kun?"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["This is Elizabeth. She's a resident here, like myself.", "It's been years since we've had a guest.", 'Only those who have signed the Contract can enter this place. Henceforth, you will be welcome here in the Velvet Room. You are destined to hone your unique ability, and you will require my help to do so. I only ask one thing in return ... that you abide by the Contract, and assume responsibility for the choices you make.', 'You became unconscious after awakening to your "Power". It\'s nothing to worry about, though. So just relax. By the way ... I see it was Orpheus who heeded your calling.', 'The time has come for you to wield your power. The tower that you are about to venture into ... how did it come to be? For what purpose does it exist? Regrettably, you are not yet capable of answering these questions. That is why you must be made aware of the nature of your power.', 'And when you have defeated your enemies, you will see the faces of possibility before you. There may be times when they are difficult to grasp ... but do not fear. Seize what you have earned. Your power will grow accordingly ... be sure to keep that in mind.', "But please come again of your own accord. I'll tell you then about my true role ... the manner in which I can best assist you. Until then ... farewell.", "Welcome to the Velvet Room. Well, I suppose it's time for me to explain what I really do here. It is my job to create new Personas. But in order to do that, I must fuse your Persona cards together. In other words, I shall merge them into a single Persona.", "Several seasons have come and gone since I first offered my assistance. Now then, your special power, Persona ... I trust you've been using it wisely?", 'But it would be a pity to lose one such as yourself unnecessarily ... therefore, please allow me to provide you with a new form of assistance.', "Now, then. There has been a change in you recently. Have you noticed? I am not referring to your change in circumstances; I am referring to the change in your mentality. That is why I have summoned you here tonight. Going forward, there is one thing you mustn't forget ...", 'There is no need to worry. Whichever path you choose, I shall respect your decision. However, only you will bear the responsibility for your actions ... no matter what end they may bring about. Please remember that.']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["hmm ... what kinda people r we, playing inside on such a beautiful day? yeah, games r cool, but like ... (gawd this sounds pathetic--) there isn't much else that intersts me, ya know? ._.", 'but hey, grinding gets old rite? its more fun talking to u, tatsuya.', "i rly like how you have good spelling and punctuation online. that's so 1337.", "... ugh. its like all she cares about is marrying me to some dude. >=/ i'm taking my time!!1 =/ there's no rush, yo.", "... my muscles are sore, but i'm soooooo buff! there's nothing a little endorphins wont cure, rite?", "if Mr. E starts playin this game too i'm putting him on ignore! xD u can't talk to him either, k? hee hee ... pwned!", "mkay, i'll be calm. i'll compose my bitching carefully for you. ;p one of my coworkers is really pissing me off. i'm trying to avoid her @_@ we use to teach teh same grade and we were together ALL THE TIME, its been a while but that kinda thing sticks w/u, u know?", "some student asked her out, and a guy she doesn't liek proposed to her ... ugh! and she acts like its nuthing! omg, rite?", 'i wanted to tell u last time but i chickened out ...', 'none of the male teachers r even in my league, so i gave up looking for b/fs @ work ...', 'it said their cancelling innocent sin. ... think its for real?', "don't mess w/maya & friends or u'll regret it! MwahAHaHhaHa! next time we'll celebrate our victory, k? bai!", 'i drew something in the sand for u, check the ground once i log off, k? ^^; its kinda embarassing but i worked real hard on it ... if u upload a screenie to ur cellphone, u can keep it always!', 'remember, lets think positive!', "Minato Arisato ... 11th grade, correct? Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['Take a look ... name, address, etcetera ... this is you, right?', "Doesn't matter ... we've held up our end of the bargain. Besides, tomorrow this will seem like some random crime.", 'Hold up.', "What're ya gonna do ... ? I know they asked you to come back.", "They're goin' down, ya hear me? And if you're on their side, then you're going down too.", "If the Shadows and the Dark Hour disappear, then so will our power. And we can't let that happen, now can we?", 'You\'ve each got your own reason for fighting. "Justice" is only an excuse.', "For us, it's not that simple ... it has to be forced out. Sorry, but those are your words, not mine.', 'Go do what you came for.', 'Hey, hurry up, Chidori!', "Don't forget about your mission! This is just a waste of energy!", "Takaya went on ahead of me. He's destined for greater things ...", 'I pieced together the information Ikutsuki left behind ... but not all of it made sense. He was a real nut job.', 'We were surprised to find out that he was your boss. We really only knew his name ...', "Heh ... there's no use in telling you. The end is near.", "Can't let you do that, little lady. There's no way you'll be able to stop Nyx, but I can't let you interfere with Takaya's wish.", 'I would do anything for Takaya ...', "Heh ... you wouldn't understand. Takaya showed me the light when I was in the darkness. It was a long time ago ...", "You idiots! I don't want your pity!"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['I transferred here when I was in 8th grade. I know how tough it is bein\' the new kid ... So I wanted to say "hey." ... See what a nice guy I am?!', "I didn't think we'd be in the same class again.", "What? But, I was just bein' friendly ...", "Um, hello? I asked this yesterday, but what's this Tartarus thing again?", 'Hm ... ?', 'Whoa ... their nest, huh?', "Relax, I've got your backs.", 'Labyrinth ... ? What are you talking about?! What happened to our school?!', 'This is the "nest" you were talking about? But, why?! Why\'d our school turn into a giant tower?!', "So you two didn't plan on coming in the first place?", 'For real? ... One of us?', "W-wait! Why him?! he doesn't look like a leader!", 'Seriously?', 'Y-yeah, of course I can!', "Yeah, what's up? You look like a zombie. Don't tell me you just dozed off! You're like the coach who fell asleep during that championship game! Come on, man, you're s'posed to be our leader!", 'So this is it, huh?', 'Whoa! Is that you, Senpai?', 'Wait ... ya mean you can see inside here?', 'Right!', "Wow ... I never knew I had that kinda power! We kicked some ass! But damn, I'm beat ...", 'You look pretty tired yourself, Yuka-tan.', "You can say that again! There's like some kinda aura around her ... besides, this school's owned by the Kirijo Group, right?", 'So ... do you have any idea what she just said?', "Me neither ... we live in the same dorm, but it's like we're on different planets ... man, if she asks for my opinion, I don't know what I'll say ...", "I heard no one was even close to her in the election. I mean, come on! You don't even see girls flock like that on TV! I wonder where they're going ...", 'Hell yeah! Whatcha got in mind?', "Th-the police station?! You mean, we're not hangin' out with your friends ... ?", "Man, how can he not know their names?! I mean, seriously! Just look at them! ... Oh well, let's go.", 'R-really?! Sweet!', "He said you're a pretty cool guy. I've known him for a long time, even though we don't usually hang out. He's a good guy, and man ... he has no fear when it comes to the ladies.", "Who cares? The Principal doesn't know anything about the Shadows, anyway. I just hope this doesn't take too long ...", "Yeah, you're right ... what's up with that?!", 'You know, those games you play with a buncha people you never met before. I was totally addicted to this one game, but then I got burned out ... here, you can have it.', 'Yup, he knows who he can count on.', 'H-hey, I resent that!', 'The class roster for 2-E.', 'Of course, senpai.', "You know, I'm into games too ...", "Three-day weekend starting tomorrow! I asked some peeps if they wanted to hang out, but the only ones interested were guys ... man, I don't want no sausage fest ...", "Where is it? I'll rip it a new one!", 'Him again ... ?', "Are you serious?! Isn't that dangerous ... ?", 'But your bike ...', "He's been Transmogged, huh ... creepy. There are many strange things in this world ... according to one story ... if you get caught at school late at night, you\'ll be devoured by a maniacal ghost that roams the halls! He said it was about the girl in 2-E ... he claims he saw her go into the school on the night of the incident. I couldn\'t believe it. Prolly already healed, huh ... so how come you're not drawing today?", 'Well, uh, not really ...', "You can do that?! That's incredible, Chidori!", 'Well, yeah, I guess ... but ...', "WIthout that ... I'd be a nobody. I just talk a big game, pretendin' like I'm some kinda hero. But in reality ... I don't know what the hell I'm fighting for ... or why I'm here at all.", "That one ady, I'd grow up to be a pro baseball player. Pretty stupid, huh? I guess that's part of bein' a kid.", 'Huh?', "Yeah, me too ... I'm sorry ...", "Chidori ... I ... I understand. I won't let you down.", "Yeah, thanks to that, the school festival got canned. Well, setting all that stuff up is a pain, so I don't mind, but it sucks that we'll be stuck indoors.", 'What about you, Fuuka?', 'Oh, a movie? Is it a date ... ?', "How 'bout you, Yuka-tan? Will ya still have practice?", 'What about you, Senpai?', 'Man, Ai-chan, you must be psychic. And ya know what? She WANTS me to come! Not to brag or anything ... I, um ... just thought I should check up on her. Ya know, with the storm and all.', 'Come on, you have to be doing something.', "Dude, you're a kid, not an old man.", 'Oh, okay. call me if you get stuck.', "It's okay. At least he's coming, right?", 'Hello? I was tied up, remember?! Sheesh, give a guy a break.', 'Punishment ... ? What is this, kindergarten?', "Anyway, why was Akihiko-san acting so weird? What's so special about October 4th?", 'You serious?!', "No way ... are you shittin' me?!", "That's not good.", 'Tch ...', "I knew this wasn't a game, but I never thought it'd end up like this ...", "That's cool, man ...", "So where's Akihiko-san?", 'You sure?', 'Nah, we were just wondering what you were up to.', "Uh, are you sure you're alright?", 'It was a lot better than doing nothing, right? Besides, we made some new friends.', 'How about you, Mitsuru-spenai? You started before Akihiko-san, right?', 'What the hell were they thinking?!', 'Ooh! In that case, how about sushi?!', "Hey, wait a minute! You can't do that!", "For real?! Aw man, it's great to be alive!", 'What?! But it was my idea in the first place!', "Man, I'm starving ... can we eat?", "Sweet! I've been waiting for you to say that!", "I have an idea ... how 'bout we all take a picture? Actually, I tried to take one last night, but I forgot it wouldn't work during the Dark Hour.", "Oh, wait, Ikutsuki-san and Aigis aren't here ... I guess we'll have to take another one later. Alright, everyone get together.", 'No way ...', "Ikutsuki-san, what's this all about?!", "Man, he's totally lost it ...", "Mitsuru-senpai's not here, huh?", "So what're we supposed to do now? ... what'll happen to Chidori?", 'What the hell ... am I supposed to just wait for them to get their act together?', "Yeah, but standin' around here won't solve anything, right?", "A lot's been goin' on.", "Hey, what's wrong? ... So you heard about Jin and Takaya, huh? I was planning on telling you ... they were your friends, after all. What, that's not it?", "Two years? I dunno. I really haven't thought about it. Why do you ask?", "Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to ...", 'Huh?!', "Wh-whaddya mean?! I don't understand! Did I do something wrong?", 'But ... Chidori ...', 'Whoa, nice place!', "That's right, I forgot about that! Count me in!", "So where were you guys gonna go at your old school, Ryoji? Somewhere interesting, I bet. Kyoto's so typical, don't ya think?", '... You heard her.', "Yeah, but it's not like we could get expelled for this, right? I mean, it was men only when we got here. So it's actually kinda funny if you think about it.", 'Huh? O-Oh, nothing ...', "It doesn't make any sense! I mean, I know I'm not that smart, and I've done a lot of stupid stuff ... but we shouldn't be fighting like this!", 'Chidori ... ! Why?!', "Chidori, please ... tell me why you're doing this ...", 'Huh ... ?', "What the hell does that mean, you friggin' ghost?!", 'You bastard ...', 'Chidori ... ? Huh ... ? I-I thought I was ...', 'I, um, I ... I want to be with you, too.', 'What ... ?!', 'Chidori ...', 'Die ... huh?!', 'Huh ... ?', "This is so hard ... but ... it's not just my life anymore ...", 'So whaddya want?', "I know I have to snap outta this, but it's just so hard ...", "... It's like she's telling me to stop moping around ...", "Yeah, but Mitsuru-senpai said that it's okay during the day.", "But you don't seem that different.", "So if we were all like you ... we wouldn't have to worry about dying ...", "... but we don't have any Shadows to kill. Man, this sucks.", "What ... ? That's BULLSHIT!", '...', 'He started drinking after he was tricked into investing his lfie savings in some telemarketing scam ...', "Nothing, really. I come here when I'm feeling down ...", 'Yeah. This is where I first met her ...', "I see. You know, you've really changed, Fuuka. You're totally different from when you first came to the dorm.", "Yeah. You were so timid back then, but now you're so ... strong.", "I mean, just the other day I got all freaked out about being scared ... I'm such a wuss.", 'But I really was scared ... actually, I still am.', "If I forget everything, that means I'll forget Chidori, too ... and I wouldn't even be alive right now if it wasn't for her, ya know?", 'Fuuka ...', "True to yourself ... you're really something, Fuuka.", "Yeah, this isn't like you.", "The only one who can tell you what your purpose is, is you. that's why we're having such a hard time making our decision. There's just no easy answer.", "I wouldn't be here if I wasn't on board.", 'Me either ...', 'Uhh, what ... ?', "N-no, I'm not, I'm just going for a walk ...", "Alright then, let's go.", "It's almost Coming of Age Day, ya know ... I used to just think of it as a day off, but now I wonder if I'm even gonna live long enough to celebrate it. It's been pretty weird around here lately ... people have been passing out, others have gone missing. Dude, it's crazy.", "... It's all gotta be because of this Nyx. Oh, and have you heard about that doomsday cult? They've been running around town telling everyone they see that the end of the world is coming ... man, we need to do something, and quick.", "They haven't done anything yet, but I know they've gotta be planning something, and we need to take care of them too.", "But then again, I never thought it would come to this. Ya know, I don't think it's completely hit me yet ... it's just all so hard to believe, but that doesn't mean we should just sit around and wait for it to happen.", "That thing was inside you for ten years, and you harnessed its power and made it your own ... I'm glad I met you. It's embarassing to say it, but ... that's really how I feel.", "Akihiko-san's NEVER treated us all to ramen before.", "Tch, not this again ... come on Akihiko-san, a bet's a bet. Pay up!", 'That son of a bitch ...', 'Oh, sorry. Hey, what\'s up with them calling him the "charismatic one"? How\'d he get so popular all of a sudden?', "TO tell you the truth, I never even would've thought about my own death if none of this had happened ... but since we've made up our minds, why don't we just leave it at that? Our objective is Nyx. If Strega gets in our way, we'll just have to deal with them too.", 'Yeah.', 'We know you will, Yuka-tan!', "Yeah, that's probably our best bet. Graduation Day it is! Now where should we meet?", "Good, 'cuz I'm countin' on ya!", "But ... we can't ...", "Yeah, just lie there and repent for what you've done."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["You got it. You're the guy who went out with Yukari Takeba on the first day of school, right? You're practically famous.", "Then, long story short: from now on, you're mine after school. Just because you joined mid-season, don't think I'll go easy on you!", 'Wanna go for a jog before lunch is over?!', "... How 'bout you? You okay? You've been pushing the pace ... you don't even look tired. What kind of training have you been doing?", "Minato ... you're crazy. This sucks ... you destroyed me ... I knew the Bay Area competition would be tough, but I never expected to be going up against someone like you. ... I've made up my mind!", "I'll show you what I'm made of! ... Hm? ... ?! Dammit, y-you serious ... ?!", "The big meet is next year, but don't push yoruself too hard. Minato, can you take him home?", "Um ... my asthma's just acting up ...", "Minato, I ... my knee hasn't felt right since that day you first came to practice ... even if I put medicine on it or massage it, the pain won't go away. Of course it'll heal, but I can't afford to stop training, so I'll work through the pain!", "There will be participants from all over Japan. The regional meet pales in comparison. I have to win at that meet! I can't afford to put my training on hold! There are a lot of nosy guys on the team. If they find out, they'll keep bugging me about it ... Minato, please keep it a secret, alright?!", "Hey, you're almost up, Minato! You ready to do this?!", "Just give it everything you've got! It takes guts to win! Don't give in to fear! Alright, dude! Go for it!", 'Whoa, dude! How many laps left?!', 'You did great, dude! Looks like all your hard work paid off.', "They say Hayase just blows everyone else away. I thought people were just exaggerating, but man, he's insane! We could sure use someone like him on our team ... agh! Next time, we won't lose!"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['Do you know him, Fuuka-san?', "Oh, so this is him, huh? You must be Minato-kun. I've heard a lot about you from Fuuka-san!", "O-oh, that's right.", "Things are going well ... Fuuka-san decided to return to the club, and now we're getting a new member. Maybe I should stay club leader for a little longer ...", 'No, I ... uh ... h-hey Minato-kun, are you a good painter?', "We don't have any proefssional artists in this club. I mean, I'm a novice and I'm the leader. Meeting you like this can't be just a coincidence ... it must be fate. So if you're interested in joining the Art Club, just write your name on the sign-up sheet."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['It happened two years ago.', "I've heard a lot about you. You haven't lost a boxing match yet.", "My name is Ken Amada. I'll be staying here for awhile. I'll try to stay out of everyone's way, so don't mind me.", "... it can't be ...", "Now I know, and I'm ready to do it ... my mind is made up.", 'I believe I can be of some assistance ... now I finally know why I was given this power.', "Nice to meet you all. I'll try not to get in anyone's way.", 'Yes, got it!', "It looks very natural on you; no one will suspect a thing. But why does he want you to go to school? it's not like there's anything special about it.", "His backpack isn't here, so I don't think he's been home yet.", 'H-how are we supposed to beat something like that?!', 'Is it some sort of room ... ?', "Well, I'll probably go visit the shrine.", "But that's where I always go ...", "Anyway, I'm going back to my room. I have a lot of homework to do ...", '... Do you know why I asked you to meet me here? Two years ago today ... October 4th.', "They called it an accident, but it wasn't. I saw the whole thing ...", "... Since then, it's been one bad thing after another. And all I get from people is sympathy, no matter where I go. ... What's the point in living?", 'You said once that you wanted to forget what happened on that day, so when I knew it was a full moon today, I knew I had to confront you. Today, Mom is watching over me.', '...', 'Is that supposed to change my mind ... ?', "What's he talking about?!", "What does he mean ... ? You're going to die ... ? No matter what I do?", '...', 'Wait!', "... Yes. That's the only reason they let me join.", "It doesn't matter anymore ... I'll never have my revenge. I have no reason to live ...", "To this day, it's still on file as an unexplained accident. That's why I wanted to make it clear ... I thought that's what she would have wanted. Maybe then she'd finally be at peace ...", "And once again, I'll be left behind ...", '...', "I've known it all along; I've just been lying to myself. I was consumed by hatred ... I couldn't face the thought of being alone ... but that's exactly what happened ...", "... I've made up my mind.", '...', 'You were?', "Yes. ... I won't run off again.", "I'm positive.", '... Yeah, I guess.', 'Those bastards ...', "You should all be ashamed of yourselves, fighting over sushi ... Senpai, please order tamago for me. They say you can tell a chef's skill by how he prepares eggs.", 'Hey, where are Ikutsuki-san and Aigis-san?', "Yeah, something didn't feel right.", 'You tricked us?!', '... Death?', 'It\'s in the papers, too. "Sudden Death of Kirijo Group\'s CEO." They blame it on illness, though.', 'What was that he said about "the Fall"? What would\'ve happened if we had been sacrificed?', "Other Persona-users ... ? Don't tell me it's ...", 'This is all so sudden ...', '... Have you made your decision, Sanada-san?', "Well, I was planning to ... but when I thought about what I was gonna say to her, it just didn't feel right. There are things I still need to do before I talk to her again.", "An undefeatable enemy, huh? Gosh, i wonder what it's like ...", "I'm in, too.", "Oh, that's too bad. Yukari-san and the others are already there. They're all wearing kimonos.", "Oh, I'll go too!", 'Neither will I!', 'Graduation Day! Yes, that will be easy to remember.', "I-I don't believe you!"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["Man, I knew it. I heard from Junpei that you're pretty close with Yukari-san. ... What's up with that? Well, I guess it doesn't matter. I'm looking for someone with a little more experience anyway. By the way, I'm Kenji Tomochika. There's a morning assembly, so we better hurry.", "Dude, I thought the rumor about you and Yukari-san was true ... well, it's not like I care or anything. But you've sure had some bad luck since you transferred here. You know, dude, all the weird stuff that's been happening. How everyone's been saying they're hearing strange voices ... well, I guess since you're always listening to your headphones, you probably haven't heard anything.", "No reason, really. I just don't have anything to do later and I thought we could finish our conversation from this morning. So whaddaya say, man? Let's get some ramen and talk.", "Whew! Now that's what I'm talkin' about! Well, was I right or what? This ramen tastes great, doesn't it? I bet they put a special ingredient in it ... something no other ramen shop uses. It's probably some sort of secret spice ... oh, sorry, my bad. I get all geeked up when I eat here.", "Wow, you don't look like the type of guy I'd normally hang around with, but I guess looks aren't everything. By the way, man, I hear you and Yukari are close. Damn boy, you move fast! I mean, you just transferred here. I can't blame you, though. A man's gotta be aggressive nowadays.", "We'll get some food and I'll tell you about my secret plan. Wait 'til you hear about it, dude. You're gonna flip!", "So can you, like, go into Yukari-san's room and stuff? No, huh? That's what I thought. Well, I'm not interested in girls her age anyway. When it comes to women, I like them to be older than me. What about you?", 'That\'s awesome. Good for you, man. Well, to tell you the truth, I ... wait, this is just between us, okay? I have my eye on someone. This is the "secret plan" I was talking about. I\'m going to ask her out.', "Anyway, I want you to be there when I ask her out. But you gotta promise you won't tell anyone, okay?", "You doing anything after school? If you're looking for something to do, come talk to me, man. I'll be at my desk. Well, I guess I should go study ... NOT! I mean, who needs to study, right? Hahaha ...", 'You have anything planned for tomorrow? Wanna get together?', "Really? Cool! Alright then, tomorrow it is! Don't forget!", "D'z is a great singer, and he looks so cool on stage!", 'Hmm ... .', "You're pretty good looking to begin with, man, so if you work on how you dress, you'll be good to go. Then you can be my wingman!", "Dude, I've been sick of school since my first day freshman year. I mean, I wake up, come to school, listen to lameass lectures, come home, eat, watch TV, go to sleep ...", "Thanks, dude! Soon I'll have a girlfriend, just like you!", "Her name is Ms. Kanou. You don't know her, do you? She teaches 12th grade ethics. I'm totally acing her class.", "Hey, man, don't tell anyone about this, okay? You're the only one who knows.", "Well, I heard he knows more about food than anyone ... people are always asking him for reccomendations on where to eat. Well, I major in noodles, so there's nothing he can tell me about ramen that I don't already know. I mean, he goes to Hagakure and orders rice-based dishes ... what a loser! I guess he's into sandwiches now, so he's always hanging around Paulownia Mall. I wonder who he is ...", "Never leave 'em hanging, that really makes 'em mad. Oh, and NEVER break a promise. That's, like, the worst thing you could ever do. And remember, chicks get jealous easily. If your chick sees you walking home with another chick, you're dead, dude.", "But I kinda took her away from them, ya know, dude? Like I made her my girl before they even had a chance ... Emiri is a really strict teacher, but at home she's a real sweetheart. She's always ...", "It's like a TV show, dude! Seriously! What about you, Minato? How are you and Yukari-san doing? Well, I wish you all the happiness in the world, dude.", "I'm trusting you, man.", "I forgot I have to go check out that cram school today, so I don't have time to eat ramen. Sorry, man.", "But the future's a long way off, dude. I mean, first I have to go to college, right? All of Emiri's students go to good colleges. She must be thinking about our future together ...", "Dude, listen to this. I've got a serious problem.", "I made up my mind, man. As soon as I graduate, I'm gonna marry Emiri. I'm seriously in love with Emiri, and I'm gonna marry her!", "It's like all of a sudden, she won't take my phone calls or reply to my text messages ... she's probably only doing this to protect me, but still. I can't just sit here and do nothing ... I gotta think of a plan ...", 'Man, hanging out with you is never boring! But that being said, I want a girlfriend, dude.', "When Emiri left, I was really sad, but I'm not sure what I was sad about ... did I really love Emiri, or did I just love the idea of being in a relationship with a teacher? I've been thinking and thinking about it ... and I just don't know.", "You don't have much fashion sense, so I wanted to help you out. I mean, that's what best friends do, right? J-just take it, man!"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['Who are you? Mom and Dad said not to talk to bad people ... are you bad?', "There's something I really want ... I'm soooo hungry ... I want to eat something that's round and hot! And soft too ...", "That was so yummy I ate them all! But, now I'm thirsty ... I'm sooooo thirsty! I want something fizzy!", 'Come play with me again, okay?', "I guess it is getting dark ... but I don't wanna go home yet!", "Can't we stay together a little longer?", "I tell them I want us to be happy, but they don't listen. They probably hate me, too..hey, we can play again later, right? I think we're friends now. I have cram school on Sunday, but I'm free the rest of the days.", "Have you seen Striped Shirt? We were playing tag, but it's no fun if I can't find him.", "You don't look so good ... are you sick?", 'Huh? S-so you ARE sick?', "No fair! I'm an innocent girl, so I actually believed you!", 'You can eat with us too, Striped Shirt!', "But I have a birthday soon. Oh, do you think he'll come home for my birthday?", "She hasn't asked me what I want yet.", "You're the only one who still plays with me, you know.", "At least Mom and Dad didn't forget about my birthday this year ... they remembered Course nobody could forget me!", "We used to eat dinner together every night ... how come Mom and Dad don't get along anymore?", "If I can get rid of the reason, everything'll be fine, right? I'm going to do whatever it takes to get my parents back together! You'll do what you can to help, right?", 'Why would Dad do that? Why? All I did was say I wanted to know the real reason they were getting a divorce. They told me I was too young to even understand it. So I kept asking, and Dad got angry, and then he ... he ... then Mom said since I was so annoying, that it was my fault.', "I bet they wouldn't care if I was even there at all! What if I ran away from home ... ? I want to find out how they really feel about me ...", 'I yelled at them to please stop fighting so much ... but they told me to just leave them alone.', "I'd better start packing soon ... what do you think I need to pack if I'm running away from home? I'll need lots of snacks, right? What about my health insurance card? Maybe my PJs and my toothbrush ... what else?", "Don't worry. I'm going to be just fine, okay? I'm gonna miss you, though ... it won't be easy to be alone.", 'Well, I ... um ... I ...', "Yeah, I'm okay ...", "Y-you guys made me worry too! I was so scared ... you said you were getting a divorce, and I didn't know what to do! I don't want you to get divorced because of me!", "They talked to me about why they were getting divorced. I was sad, but I listened to what they said ... they said when there's no love, it's hard to still be married. They said not to worry, because they would always love me.", "Even if you don't have love, you still have to try!", "I'm going to live with Mom, since she has to cook and clean and go to work ... I want to help out too! I don't have to worry about Dad ... even without me around, I think Dad will be okay on his own.", "... I'm leaving today, an' Dad said that even though we're far away, we're still family. I think that should go for friends like you and me, too, so I don't have to be sad. I think family is important ..."]
