Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["Minato, and this is my very first entry...first real one, I guess. Stupid journal. I don't really know what to write about in these things...I'm only doing this because a friend from my old school asked me to. No idea why she didn't just have me get a Myspace, or why she insisted on making the account and picking the username for me, but she said I have to use this one so I guess I should get used to it. She'll probably read this eventually, so, uh...hi?  Girls are weird.", '"Ramenboi?" And "1990" isn\'t even my birth year...', "Anyway, today was my first day at my new school, Gekkoukan High. It was interesting, I guess. I met a few new people and all that. I'm more interested in what happened last night before I got to the dorm where I'm staying...but I don't know how to put it into words, really. I'm not much of a writer...I guess if you're interested you could just watch the animation I made about it. It's in the last entry. After you do that, you might wanna watch another animation I made about it...", "This is Mitsuru, she pretty much runs things around the dorm where I'm staying. She's kind of a scary ice queen chick.", "This is Yukari. She really does have a gun, but you can't really see it here. I decided not to bring it up right away...I want to at least try to fit in here, y'know? Maybe there's some kind of toy gun fad here? Maybe she's just a freak. So I just said it was nice to meet her.", 'I guess I need to think positive, huh...', "She asked if I had any questions, and the one that was eating at my mind was who exactly that kid with the contract was. Seemed like he'd been playing too much GTA or something. I read somewhere that that fucked kids up.", "Aaaand she didn't have any idea what I was talking about. I knew sleeping on the bus before the subway ride to the dorm was a bad idea. Now she thinks I'm crazy.  I'm already off to a great start...", "Well, no, everything turned green and bloody and coffin-y, but I can't tell her that when she already thinks I'm seeing creepy little kids in the dorm. So I played dumb.", 'Well, yeah, like that question about the whole gun thing. But whatever. I hit the sack pretty soon after that. Figured I was seeing things because I was tired.', "I woke up the next morning to Yukari pounding away on my door like crazy. I have a Bullet for my Valentine alarm clock, y'know...anyway, I let her in.", 'I went ahead and asked her what class she was in...I figured it would be nice to have someone I at least kind of knew in my class.', 'I talked to a few of the kids around the board before I took a look at it...', "...and it wasn't really all that exciting, so I went up to check which class I was in.", "Doesn't it figure mine's not on there? I checked again, just in case...", '...and got lucky for the first time in my life. Thank god.', "So now anyone from school who reads my journal knows: I am in Class F. That is me with the black hair. Say hi...if you want. It'd be nice, I guess. After that, I looked around a bit and headed for the Faculty Office...", "...as we see in this fascinating drawing. Art doesn't always have to be about exciting subjects, you know. And everything you draw is practice, so there's no reason not to do it. It's my journal, anyway, I can post what I want, so there.", 'This is my Composition teacher, Ms. Toriumi.', "What a bitch. I really wish she hadn't brought that up. I don't even like to think about it.", 'So I did, and we went to the auditorium, and the Principal gave a really, really boring speech about trying your best or something. Give me a break.', 'Some guy asked me a question during the assembly...', 'How the fuck was I supposed to know? Geez, I just got here. I was nice when I told him I had no idea, at least, so score one for level thinking.', 'I was actually kinda thankful this teacher came along and bitched us out, since it made that guy stop interrogating me about a chick I just met. Anyway, school was school (boring as hell, in other words) but more stuff happened afterwards.', 'This guy just came right up and started acting like he was my best buddy in the world. What the hell?', 'I had no idea who he was and said so.', "So yeah, this is Junpei. He seems pretty dopey, but I guess he's alright.", "Yukari's in our class, too, and she showed up right around then.", 'Yuka-tan?', 'Ugh, christ, not this again.', '...Am I really that bad?', "She asked me about last night again. I still have no idea why she's so worried about it, and it's really just making me more suspicious.", "She took off, and left me feeling like shit. I don't see why it'd be such a big deal...then again, I DO have a pretty stupid Livejournal username. Maybe girls can smell that kind of thing.", "I guess Junpei's not really that bad, though.", 'I\'m "da man"? Well, whatever. He took off too, and I headed home, where I\'m working on this entry now. A little more happened, but I\'m fried, so I\'ll wrap things up tomorrow. "Da man" is going to bed.', 'Coming up in the next entry: More of the same...or is it? We call that a "teaser".', 'Current Mood:  I have no idea.', "Current Music: I'm too...something to listen to music right now.", "Minato here. Uh...I don't really know how to explain any of this. You might notice my journal is on friends only for the time being...and that I don't have any friends yet, so it's not like anyone can see this. That's probably for the best. Have you ever drank one of those convenience store slushies and gotten brain freeze? My whole body feels like that right now. It sucks.", "I guess I can best explain what's up if I start with the boring stuff and move up in excitement from there, kinda like the Matrix movies backwards. He carried all the dreams and nightmares of humanity within himself, including his own, and he would draw upon their power in this final battle.", 'Knowing this, he and his friends finally ascended the last staircase in Tartarus.', 'Darkness awaited them.', 'Pure, unmitigated darkness.', 'How could they have been prepared?', 'Nyx Avatar stood before them.', 'I stood before them.', 'Our paths had finally crossed once more, for what I believed would be the last time.', "Nyx's arrival was at hand...", '...and as a part of her, it was my duty to secure her arrival.', 'She was Death. I was Death. The Fall had finally arrived.', 'Yet, they showed no apprehension. The fear and trembling they had displayed when they first learned of the fate of mankind was no more, replaced by a grim determination.', 'Foolishness.', 'Insanity, even.', 'Yet there they were.', 'They knew what faced them...', '...and they were ready to tackle it head on.', "I think that's what I like the most about humanity.", 'They have faith.', "Now, more than ever, they'd need it.", "Magician: (Fire attacks) The moment man devoured the fruit of knowledge, he sealed his fate...entrusting his future to the cards, man clings to a dim hope. Yes, the Arcana is the means by which all is revealed. Attaining one's dream requires a stern will and unfailing determination.", "Priestess: (Ice attacks) The silent voice within one's heart whispers the most profound wisdom.", "Emperor:  (Wind attacks) Celebrate life's grandeur...its brilliance...its magnificence.", 'Empress: (Lightning attacks) Only courage in the face of doubt can lead one to the answer.', 'Hierophant: (Physicals) It is indeed a precious gift to understand the forces that guide oneself.', 'Lovers: (Status effects, specifically Panic and Charm) There is both joy and wonder in coming to understand another.', "Chariot: (Power Charged physicals) One of life's greatest blessings is the freedom to pursue one's goals.", 'Justice: (Light attacks) To find the one true path, one must seek guidance amidst uncertainty.', "Hermit: (Status effects, Dark attacks, Makarakarn and Tetrakarn) It requires great courage to look at oneself honestly, and forge one's own path.", 'Fortune: (All elements simultaneously) Alongside time exists fate, the bearer of cruelty.', 'Strength: (Rakunda, Rebellion, and Power Charged physicals) Only with strength can one endure suffering and torment.', 'Hanged Man: (Mind Charged Almighty attacks, Mudo attacks) In the face of disaster lies opportunity for renewal.', 'Death: The moment man devoured the fruit of knowledge, he sealed his fate...entrusting his future ot the cards, man clings to a dim hope. Yet, the Arcana is the means by which all is revealed. Beyond the beaten path lies the absolute end. It matters not who you are. Death awaits you.', 'They fought against overwhelming odds, and it seemed as if they had persevered...', "...but that wasn't the case.", 'There was nothing they could do. The Fall was here.', "Takaya, as it turns out, wasn't quite dead yet.", 'He had come to watch the Fall...', '...knowing as they did that resistance had truly proven impossible.', 'Nyx was awake.', 'Chaos had taken hold of the city.', "Minato's friends...", '...every last one of them...', '...were all awake, afraid, and helpless.', 'They still had hope, though.', "That's the most important thing.", "Minato had collapsed under Nyx's omnipotent assault...", '...and he found himself in the Velvet Room with Igor and Elizabeth.', 'All of his friends were calling out to him.', 'Every person whose life he had touched in the past year was trying with all their might to give him strength.', 'He could feel it rushing through him...', '...as the power began to take shape.', 'Bunkichi and Mitsuko was calling out to him. He remembered their struggle to preserve life in the form of a persimmon tree.', 'Maya was calling out to him. He remembered how she had been depending on him and was depending on him now, though they had never met.', 'Maiko was calling out to him. He remembered how she had persevered as her life fell to pieces around her, staying strong in the face of what must have seemed like the end of the world.', 'Bebe was calling out to him. He remembered how Bebe had done his best to fight for what he believed to be right.', 'Tanaka was calling out to him. He remembered how Tanaka had shown that he had good intentions...in his own way.', 'Mutatsu was calling out to him. He remembered how Mutatsu had decided to face his fear.', 'Mamoru was calling out to him. He remembered how Mamoru had stood his ground, even in the face of hardship.', 'Akinari was calling out to him. He remembered how Akinari learned how to stand courageously in the face of death.', 'Each of them cried out for him, prayed that he had the strength to make it through the final trial...and from deep within, his soul answered.', 'The energy coalesced into a glowing card.', 'The power to save the world hovered before him.', 'The final Arcana had revealed itself to Minato.', 'He had claimed the power of the Universe.', 'Minato would face Nyx herself...', '...and he would be victorious. Not just for himself, but for everyone.', 'When Minato activated the power of the Universe and unleashed the Great Seal, everything went black...', '...and his friends found themselves floating in a field of stars.', 'Myself included, though not in such a physical form.', 'Minato had been ready to give everything for humanity...', '...and it seemed as if he had done just that.', 'Even still...', '...his friends had hope.', 'So I spoke to them.', 'He had fought so hard...', '...given so much...', '...sacrificed everything...', "...and given the world a miracle. Nyx hadn't been defeated, of course; you can't defeat Nyx. It's impossible.", 'For now, however, she would sleep.', "I'm glad I was human, if only for awhile. It meant I was able to meet the savior of humanity; we were even friends, and I think we still are, despite all that's happened.", 'The End of the Dark Hour (Archive damaged!', "...the story isn't over yet, of course, but humans are funny things. I don't think I could tell the rest of it myself.", "So instead, I'll let him tell you.", 'Coming up in the next entry: Memento Mori - remember that you are mortal.', "Hey everybody. I know it's been awhile since my last entry, but...I dunno. I've just been really tired lately. I know that's no excuse or anything, but...sorry.", 'Anyway, after we defeated Nyx, everything went back to normal...well, maybe a little too normal.', "Remmber how everyone was worried about losing our memories after the final battle? It turns out that's what actually happened...", "...but it didn't affect me, probably because I've still got the power of the Universe contained within me.", "So I've been trying to live as normally as I can, even though it's like all my friends are strangers now. It sucks, but what am I gonna tell them?", "I'm sure that'd go over really well.", "So it's been deja vu all over again, pretty much.", 'I was pretty bummed about it for awhile...', "...but lately I've been too tired to think about it.", 'All I want to do is sleep anymore.', 'I...', "...I don't know.", "I guess when I think about it, I'm really happy about how everything's turned out.", "Nyx isn't gone or anything, but at least we really do have our whole lives ahead of us now. If she wakes up again, then I'll seal her back where she belongs.", 'Same thing I did before. It was no sweat.', "No sweat at all...I can't say as much for almost being late to class, though.", "It wasn't just the other people in the dorm who couldn't remember the Fall, by the way. It's everyone. I can't say I'm surprised.", "If it had to be this way for everything to be alright again, then...I'm glad.", "I tried going to the mall after school on Wednesday, but I just couldn't get into it. I didn't want to look around the stores or anything...too tired, couldn't focus.", 'Instead, I just went home.', "I thought about going to bed early, but instead I had an urge to stop by Escapade. There was a woman there who told fortunes...I guess I've been worried about what the future holds for me lately, for some reason.", "I'm...not sure what to think about her answer. I'm not sure what to think about anything.", "I'm so tired.", "I didn't do much after school yesterday, either.", 'It was more of the same...', '...including trying to enjoy myself at the places I used to hang out at before the Fall.', "It didn't work.", 'I went to bed early again.', 'Aigis came to see me this morning.', "Aigis didn't forget, either. She looked like she was about to cry, and I couldn't blame her for that.", "She was afraid I'd leave, and...and...I told her it'd be okay, that it wouldn't happen.", 'Graduation was today. It had already begun by the time she came to get me because I slept in. No surprise there.', 'She and I went together regardless.', 'In the end, we made a promise, and it was time to keep it.', 'The class representative was in the middle of her speech when we arrived.', 'Mitsuru came on stage next.', 'Something seemed off about her speech.', 'It was then that I realized what was happening; Aigis and I snuck off to the rooftop together to avoid the ensuing commotion.', "I'm...so tired now.", 'Listen, everyone.', "I know you've all been reading this...", '...following along with our joy and our sorrow...', '...laughing and crying with us.', "I'm going to rest soon...", "...it'll be so nice. But listen.", "Nyx is sleeping now. She won't be coming for you, but one day you're going to die. Everyone is.", "That's just life...", "...and you can't fight against it. Why would you try? It's not sad, it's not wrong, it's just...life.", "I don't know when I'll talk to you all again, but...", '...do me one last favor, okay?', "Aigis found her reason for living. If you're reading this, please try and do the same.", "Life is a gift...so please don't ever take it for granted.", "Everyone's here now.", "I get to be with my friends again...I've waited so long.", "I think that seeing everyone's smiling face is my reason for living. One of my reasons, anyway.", "So I'm going to smile with them one last time, and then...", "...I'm going to sleep.", "I should talk about living life to the fullest...I mean...I'm here with Aigis, and everyone else is coming, and...", '...all I want to do is sleep forever...']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["I can tell you've been training. Hey, I was thinking ... maybe we could hang out sometime.", 'You still need to work on your technique, but if you keep at it, you could be really great. I think you might help push me to test my limits.', "Stop by sometime if you feel like it. My name's Mamoru ... nice to meet you.", "I'm impressed, Minato! Not many people can match my speed. Well, I wasn't really trying my hardest anyway. You had a lot of guts challenging me at yakoyaki, though ... I'm impressed. You have a lot of potential.", 'You put up a good fight today! See you around.', "It's not fair! Normal people get to eat whatever they want. But if that's what I have to do to win, then ... by the way, who do you consider to be your biggest rival?", "I guess when you get down to it, we're all our own worst enemies, right? You know it! There isn't really anyone left who I want to compete with ... the other guys in the club can't even keep up with me. I guess what I'm looking for is a good challenge.", 'I have this feeling we can drive each other to the limit!', "Think I should buy some for them, too? My siblings, I mean. I've got four of 'em! Our apartment's pretty small, though, so we have to pack 'em deep, haha. You won't believe how hot it gets over the summer.", "I guess his car fell off a cliff ... I'm not fishing for sympathy or anything, I just thought you should know.", 'Yum ... oh man, just a few more. This is kind of just what I do ... I like to eat pretty fast.', 'That was pretty fast compared to my record. Anyways, Minato ...', "We really didn't have the money. But then I hear about a chance at a scholarship ... do you see now why it's such a big deal? If I win, I might be able to go to college after all! I bet my mother would be really relieved.", "If he was still around, my brothers wouldn't have to worry about whether or not they'd get to eat every day. ... well, complaining isn't going to accomplish anything! I'll just have to hope for that reccomendation.", "Yeah, just ... need more training ... let's go in, yeah? I'm thirsty!", "I used to come here a lot with my teammates, but ... they wouldn't come now, even if I invited them. I don't really get along with people who don't take the club seriously. It jacks up practice, y'know? It's a lack of concentration. I used to love it there ... I spent all my time practicing in Track Team ... everyone else in Track Team and I always had so much fun.", "I'll just have to surpass them. Get even better than I am now ...", "I just feel bad, since I'm the one who asked you to hang out ... but actually my mother passed out.", "I guess she fainted from exhaustion, since she works from morning through the night ... this is my fault! ... But it's true! Look at all the trouble I cause her ... what?!", "Dammit! Why can't I do anything?! ... Look, I'm sorry about today. I didn't mean to cause even more trouble. But at least you answered your phone ... and talking kinda helped. A little.", "I just left from the hospital. I still have to pick my sister up from preschool, go shopping, cook dinner, do the laundry ... I've got so much I have to do. This is the kind of stuff Mom had to do every single day.", "Even with the scholarship, I don't think we can afford college. I mean, what about living expenses? My family can't even pay their own ... just like Dad, now Mom can't earn any money either ... I'm gonna have to support them. I don't have any choice but to give up on Track Team ...", "I'm going to take part in the meet! I devoted a lot of my life to Track Team. I'm going to take all that experience, apply what I learned, and achieve victory! I'm glad we could talk, I feel a lot better about things now. Thanks to you, I have a goal to aim for.", "Think I should bring some home? ... Wait, I don't have any more money. Oh, by the way, about my mom ... she gets to come home from the hospital soon! Hopefully I can help her a bit more, since I finally got the hang of taking care of everyone.", "One of 'em offered to pick up my sis from preschool. Everybody's been worried about me. I mean, I thought I was the only one who cared, and I ended up ignoring everyone else there. And after all that, it was probably my fault nobody seemed focused on winning.", "This is just great. I mean, i already totally loved it. Oops, guess I kinda started rambling there ... I gotta run. And don't forget ... I can focus on training again cause you've got my back! So thanks, buddy.", 'I got first place, of course! This maens my sports career might be over for real. Makes me feel a little empty, you know?', "I'm going to earn enough money to support my family. i think that's my responsibility now ... got one picked out and everything! My father had connections at a car factory, so I'll apply there. Thing is, it's pretty far away.", "I always blamed school or my family for everything. I didn't want to face the fact that I was responsible. I really lucked out, y'know? If we hadn't met, I'd still be a jerk. I won't forget you.", "My mother started crying, and she kinda blamed herself, but I want to support them. This is a new beginning in my life. It won't be easy to leave this ramen, though ... best in town. Hey, I gotta go ...", "Sometimes I get pretty pissed that he's not around anymore. My lfie wouldn't have had to be so complicated, y'know? I could've enjoyed Track Team more ... could've been a normal kid. But blaming Dad like that, it's just another way to run away from my problems.", "As long as you have the key, I'll be able to stand on my own two feet, so next time we meet I can still be proud of myself."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["... Wait, so you didn't come here to buy books? Did you come here just to show us this?", 'Very clever, dear.', 'Come visit us if you get bored.', "Remember, dear? This is Minato-chan. I'm sorry, Minato-chan. He's terribly forgetful lately. Here you go.", 'Dear? Is that the key for ... ?', "Please don't!", "Um, Minato-chan ... I'm sorry for raising my voice. Did I scare you?", 'That tree is about to bear fruit ... why now? Why do they want to cut it down now?', 'I understand their reasoning ... but if that tree is removed, I feel like the memory of my son will vanish with it ...', "They say the tree is a memorial to their former teacher ... they don't want it to be cut down.", "They've given their precious time ... for our son ... I-I don't know what to say ...", 'He was loved by everyone ...', "I'm sure he's just as happy as we are ...", "I feel bad for Minato-chan and all the people who've been campaigning to save the tree ...", "I'll tell you when the time comes, Minato-chan.", "It's difficult having such a well-respected son. Oh, does it sound like I'm boasting?"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["He's a transfer student. It was a last minute decision to assign him here. He'll eventually be moved to a room in the boys' dorm.", "I guess we'll see ...", "She'll be a junior this spring, just like you.", "It's getting late, so you should get some rest. Your room is on the second floor, at the end of the hallway. Your things should already be there.", "I've seen it on the news quite often lately. They say it's due to stress, but ...", 'You have a one track mind ... will you be okay on your own? The Chairman will be here for the next few days, but after that, I can ...', "This isn't a game, Akihiko ...", "He went to bed a little while ago. He's asleep now. Mr. Chairman, do you think he's ... ?", 'Yes sir.', 'The same as last night.', '... Is that you, Akihiko?', 'Mr. Chairman!', 'This is no time to joke around! Mr. Chairman, please head for the command room! Takeba, go upstairs and wake him up! Then escape out the back!', "We'll stop it here. You led it to us, Akihiko, so I'm afraid you'll have to fight.", 'Takeba, do you read me?!', "Be careful! There's more than one enemy! The one we're fighting isn't the one Akihiko saw!", "I'm not surprised by your reaction. However, you've already experienced this truth firsthand. Do you remember the night you came here? You had to have noticed the signs ... the streetlights went out ... nothing was working ... there were coffins everywhere ... didn't it feel like you were in a different time?", 'You just got hurt the other day!', "A Shadow feeds on the mind of its prey; the victim becomes a living corpse. They're responsible for most of the incidents on the news, if not all of them.", 'Come to the lounge when you get back to the dorm. I have something to tell everyone.', "I'll save the details for later. See you there.", "Since Akihiko hasn't fully recovered yet, he'll only come as far as the entrance.", 'What about you, Mr. Chairman?', 'Once the Dark Hour passes, everything returns to normal.', 'This is only the entrance. The labyrinth lies beyond the doorway at the top of those stairs.', "We're not asking you to go very far, and I'll be feeding you information from here.", "I'll be providing audio backup from here on out.", "It's my Persona's ability.", "Now, based on your current location, you can expect to encounter enemies at any minute. They shouldn't be too tough, but proceed with caution. Practice makes perfect.", "Keep in mind, these are real battles you'll be engaging in. Now, see if you can eliminate all the Shadows wandering this floor.", "Usually, there are more Shadows on the prowl. ... Well, at least you gained some experience in battle. Let's go back to the dorm for today. There should be an Access Point somewhere on that floor. You can use it to return to the entrance. Since there aren't any enemies to worry about, why don't you split up and search for it individually?", 'So, how was it?', "At this rate, they'll catch up to you in no time, Akihiko.", "It is my firm belief that each of us must accept the responsibility of bettering our school. However, change cannot occur without sustained effort and an unprecedented level of commitment. That is why we must restructure our daily lives to accomplish this lofty goal. I'd like each of you to dig deeply into your well of motivation and re-evaluate your convictions ... to imagine a bold new future without losing sight of the realities around you. That is the key. I am certain many of you have your own visions for the future ... for us to reap the full benefits of our education, your participation, ideas, and enthusiasm are essential. Thank you.", "Regarding our exploration of Tartarus ... Akihiko is still on the mend, so for now, I'd like you to lead the team. You never know when a powerful enemy might appear, like the one you faced the other day. It's best to be prepared, or else you may find yourself in a difficult situation. So whenever you'd like to explore Tartarus, just let me know, and I'll gather everyone here. Also, since I'm sure there are other things you will need to take care of, you may go out at night if you need to. Well, that's it. Keep up the good work.", "Exploring Tartarus can be exhausting, especially since you must do so late at night. You may find that you need a great deal of rest to recuperate. The others' conditions will vary as well, so make sure you take that into consideration before you begin exploring. If you want my evaluation of everyone's condition, don't hesitate to ask.", "Just don't take it lightly, okay? It's dangerous out there.", "A few floors up, there's a barricade preventing you from going any higher. The tower seems to have a number of these interspersed amongst its floors. I know I told you that the layout changes each day, but these barriers seem to be in fixed locations. Therefore, I'd like you to try and reach the first barricade. I'm counting on you.", "I'm sorry, but I need to talk to you after school. I have a special request for you. I apologize for being in a rush, but I don't feel comfortable asking anyone else. I'll tell you more about it after school, okay? Au revoir.", "To make a long story short, I want you to join Student Council. It's not like you'd have to participate in every activity. Just come to the Student Council room when you have time. Being President is very time consuming. I'd like to have additional help available in the event of an emergency. You understand my situation ... I'm asking you because you know what it's like to be a leader.", "... I've already made an appointment for you with the faculty adviser. You'll have to go to the Faculty Office on your own. I'm sorry I made the arrangements without your permission, but I hope you understand the position I'm in. Please go to the Faculty Office, Arisato. I'll be waiting for you in the Student Council room.", "He's the one I've been talking about the past few days. He'll be joining us in Student Council.", 'From now on you have my permission to enter the Student Council room whenever you need to. That includes after school, too. Thank you, Arisato, for joining us today.', "I see. Your ability to adapt to new situations and environments is very impressive. By the way, there's something I forgot to tell you. Most times you can find me in the lounge. However, I won't be there if there is something I must attend to.", "It may take time for Akihiko to fully heal, and I don't want anything like that to happen again. Besides, the number of victims seems to have been increasing. ... I have a bad feeling about that. We had best muster as much strength as we can.", "... It's odd, really, how quiet it's been.", "It's been a month since the attack, yet I'm certain that won't be the last time they appear outside of Tartarus.", 'Yeah. You never know when the enemy might appear.', 'To be honest, I lack the power ...', "Although, the power of Persona seems to be broader than I thought. We've even got someone who can switch Personas in the middle of battle. There's something special about his ability ... it hasn't been long since his awakening, either.", 'It must be.', "We don't know for sure, but we think it's another big one. We have to defeat any of them we find as quickly as possible. Most people don't know that the Dark Hour exists, but if half the city is destroyed, there will be panic. That must be avoided at all costs.", 'Akihiko, you stay here and wait for the Chairman.', "You still need to recover. You'll just be a hindrance.", "They'll fare better than you, in your current state. Have faith in them, Akihiko ... they're ready. You'll get your chance, but for now, wait for the Chairman.", "We're counting on you.", "Wait for me in front of the station. I'll be there as soon as I can.", "Listen carefully. Tonight, I'll be providing support from here. Everything else is the same.", "To get there, you'll have to walk on the tracks.", "Don't worry, no electronic equipment is operable during the Dark Hour, including the monorails.", "It's special. Now, if circumstances change, I'll notify you immediately. Let's get started.", 'You have to stop the Shadows before they harm the passengers. Hurry!', 'Can you all hear me?', 'The readings are definitely coming from that monorail. Proceed with caution and stay together.', "It must be the Shadow ... it knows you're there. Be ready for anything! Proceed with extreme caution!", "Something's not right ... the enemy is acting strangely.", "Minato, you're in charge over there. What do you think?", "But why did it retreat after revealing itself? It doesn't make any sense.", "We have no choice. You have to go after him, or you'll be picked off one by one.", "From what I can tell, he's only a few cars ahead.", "I don't detect any movement, but stay alert!", "It seems the monorail is under the enemy's control.", "Calm down and listen. I sense a strong presence in the front car. That must be the one we're after. You'll have to defeat it to stop the train!", "What are you waiting for?! There's a train ahead!", 'Is everybody alright?!', "I'm sorry I couldn't do more on my end. I don't detect any more Shadows. You guys did a great job, so come on home.", "This is Mitsuru. We've successfully completed the operation. The monorail didn't sustain any noticable damage.", "The team did a great job. They're learning quickly.", "If I had more power, things wouldn't be so difficult for the others.", "Do you remember how I said Tartarus was divided into different areas? I discovered through Penthesilea's power that the first barrier is gone now. I suspect that the others will be gone too, eventually ... therefore, I'd like to make reaching the top our goal. You never know what the future may hold ... we should always be prepared for the worst, and getting to the top of the tower is the most logical step. I'll let you decide on an appropriate pace, but the sooner, the better. I'm counting on you.", "I'll try to see what's up ahead. Hold on ... sorry, but I'm experiencing difficulties, possibly because of the distance ... I need more time. You may proceed for now.", 'Apparently, the decline was only temporary.', 'If we do nothing, then everyone will eventually join The Lost. Our efforts have prevented the crisis from escalating.', "There seems to be a sense of restlessness in the air. I just hope it doesn't have anything to do with Shadows. Akihiko said we may be recieving a new member, but we don't know when we'll be attacked ...", 'So, what is this ghost story about?', 'I appreciate that. The story is a bit unnerving.', "Same reason as you. Mr. Ekoda, I'm here to talk to you about a student named Fuuka Yamagishi.", 'What did you do to Yamagishi?', 'I see ...', 'But in reality, she was missing ... you must have been aware of that. What was your intention?', 'You mean you chose not to report this to the police for the "good of the class".', 'Anything at all ...', "It's them, no doubt about it ... until now, there was no way of knowing how or why some people are conscious during the Dark Hour ... this whole thing made me realize they're clearly targeting humans.", "If you hear the voice, tell us immediately. And don't leave the room, no matter what. If you can do that much, you should be okay. Don't worry, Yamagishi should be alright as well.", "We're going to rescue Yamagishi. If my guess is right, she's still inside the school.", 'Honestly, I have reservations. If something goes wrong, you could all end up lost in Tartarus too. But ...', "... Alright. We're aware of the risks, but we can't just leave her there.", "I can't get ahold of the Chairman.", "There's one problem, though. Without the Chairman's help, I'm not sure how we can get inside the school ...", 'Set to go ... ?', 'So you unlocked it earlier ... tres bien!', "Akihiko and I will check the janitor's room. You three will check the Faculty Office. After that, we'll meet in the main hallway. Got it?", 'If so, then expect to be severely punished.', "Fine. Let's head over to the janitor's room. Iori, you're coming with us.", "We'll divide into teams again. Three of you will enter Tartarus, and one of you will remain outside with me. Once the Dark Hour has begun, I'll determine Yamagishi's position.", "It's almost time.", "We still haven't heard back from them. The transceiver's sensitivity is set to high, too ...", "Unfortunately, no place is completely safe during the Dark Hour. But we couldn't possibly bring her here, and one of us staying behind was out of the question.", '...', "This is Mitsuru. I've confirmed your position. You're higher up than I expected ... you're barely in communication range. Is everyone alright?", 'Akihiko! Come in, Akihiko!', '... be carefu-- ...', 'From somewhere outside of Tartarus, just like before ...', "Actually, I don't think it'll matter.", "You might like to know that Yamagishi and Moriyama are healing up well. We'll need to invite Yamagishi to the dorm and explain what happened. We could definitely use her help.", 'You saved our lives. You should feel good about yourself. You have a special power that you can use to help others.', 'We call it "Persona". You could be a tremendous help to us. Will you lend us your strength?', "We really appreciate this. We'll have the school talk to your parents, to resolve any issues.", "Yamagishi will be living in the dorm with us, and starting tonight, she'll be providing us with support during battle. So now I can rejoin the front line. You can depend on me - even though I'm a bit out of practice, I will soon return to my prior form.", "I agree. That's about all we can do at this point.", 'In pairs ... oh, I get it.', 'And Yamagishi, I want you to handle support during the operation.', 'Thanks for your help. The enemy was sly, but you did well.', "... for withstanding the enemy's mental assault.", 'Me ... ?', "... I wasn't trying to hide anything from you. It just never seemed relevant. But ...", "... Alright. I'll tell you the whole story.", 'Some research indicates that they can even affect time and space. We think of them as our enemies, but what if we could somehow use them to our advantage?', 'Fourteen years ago, one man pursued that line of thinking ...', "I'm afraid it's just as you're thinking. Port Island must have been an ideal location for them. It was a highly-populated area, and the Kirijo Group had influence there. They could do as they pleased ...", '...', "Think what you'd like ... it was my decision not to share that information. I'm sorry ... I never intended to decieve you.", 'I ...', "Don't worry, you're not in trouble. But I do have a special favor to ask of you. I want you to find out as much as you can about that incident ten years ago.", "That's why I want you to access the Kirijo Group's database.", 'I want to know the truth in detail.', "Of course, I'll understand if you refuse.", 'Are you sure? I appreciate it.', 'After all, despite my good intentions, I did drag you into this without fully explaining. Certainly you must be a little angry with me ...', "You're right, Yamagishi. We do need you. No one can take your place.", "Mr. Chairman ... I didn't realize you were here.", 'He will ... ?', "But ... my father is a busy man; I don't want to ruin his vacation.", '... Alright.', "Don't worry about it. In a way, it's only logical that we go to Yakushima. The Chairman said that no one who was responsible for the accident is still alive, but ... in reality, there is one witness who survived.", "I'm sorry for bringing such a crowd ...", "I wasn't hiding it ...", 'But ...', '... Yes, father.', "I'm ... I'm sorry.", 'Father ... ?', "That's what he was trying to do?", 'Father ...', "I ... I can't believe it ...", 'No, Takeba, I ...', '...', "We're not currently with the others, so it might take some time for us all to assemble.", "Then we can have Yamagishi's Persona scan the area ... although, this island is quite large ...", "Listen, we've encountered a problem. I'm sorry to interrupt your vacation, but I need you all to go back to the house and prepare for battle.", 'An anti-Shadow weapon..does that mean she ... ?', "Here, this is from the Chairman. It's a reward for effectively balancing school and battle.", "There's a Shadow in the city. Yamagishi found it by chance.", "It's near Naganaki Shrine. Akihiko went ahead since he was in the vicinity. I'm sure he can handle it alone, but let's get ready just in case.", "What's wrong? Is it a powerful one?!", 'What happened?', "At any rate, let's go.", 'You know this dog?', 'First we must stop the bleeding ...', "Alright, let's report to the Chairman, so we can conclude this mission.", "It's quite impressive, considering you've also had the Shadows to contend with.", "It seems war's scars may be deeper than we think ... the situation is still unclear at this time. Therefore, we will wait until we arrive to determine who should be deployed?", "Then let's go.", 'Power ... ?', "Alright, let's concentrate on our original goal. We can look for a way out after we've won. Everyone, prepare for battle.", "Wait, there's more. Our mission was interrupted by an uninvited guest. He's most likely a Persona-user.", "And he wasn't alone. They appeared quietly during the Dark Hour and seemed to be aware of our activities.", 'Come to think of it ...', "Thank you. I have one final thing to report ... I regret to inform you that we fell right into Strega's trap, and now we're locked inside here.", "I'm sorry ... we'll be waiting.", "There's something I need to tell everyone, but I think it would be best if you saw it for yourself. Come to the fourth floor meeting room when you get home tonight, okay? I'll see you then.", "It was a surprise for me as well. But according to the tests, it's quite possible. In fact, it was the Chairman's suggestion. ... We'll be looking after him here in the dorm.", "Oh, it's no joke. We'll be taking intensive courses. I've already applied for all of us. I know how difficult it's been balancing school and our late night excursions ... you haven't had much time to study. I apologize for that. That's why the Chairman agrees that this is a good idea. ... I thought I told Takeba and Yamagishi.", "We'll meet on the 4th floor as usual. That's all.", "B-but Mr. Chairman, he's still in elementary school. Besides ...", 'You think ... ?', "We can't afford to waste any more time. Let's go.", "Alright, let's split up and search for it. There's no time to lose; hurry!", "Don't break her concentration ... .", 'Power cables?', 'Good job, Yamagishi.', "Clearly, she's emotionally unstable. We'll let her rest and save our questions for later.", 'What kind of organization is Strega? Are there others besides you three?', "She certainly has. In fact, she won't say a word. Maybe we should confiscate her sketchbook, too ...", "I'm not so sure about that. She was quite upset when we took her Evoker. Speaking of which ... where did you get that?", "Then what am I supposed to do?! ... I'll have someone else try next time.", "By refusing to speak, you're only hurting yourself. We aren't keeping you here because we hate you; we just want to avoid unnecessary confrontation.", "Iori ... it seems like you're letting your emotions get the best of you. Is everything okay?", "Apparently, we can't leave her unattended for even one moment. But fortunately, she heals at an astounding rate.", 'She finally started talking, but nothing useful yet.', 'Supressants ... ? You know about Strega?', "I haven't decided. Besides, what business is it of yours, Iori?", "Alright, let's decide on a team and engage the enemy!", "Let's return to the dorm and then go from there ...", 'Akihiko, are you listening?', 'Akihiko ... ?', "I was so caught up in the operation that I didn't realize it ... this is the day Amada's mother was killed!", "Yamagishi, I need you to find the two of them immediately. There's a good chance that they're together. Akihiko must have already realized that ...", 'It was two years ago, when we were pursuing an unusual Shadow that had escaped into the city ... we were in a residential area, but the Shadow was all we were thinking about.', 'Amada volunteered to join us. But now that I think about it ...', 'Akihiko?', "Ugh, it's an absolute nightmare!", "We need to discuss how to deal with Amada ... I've already consulted the Chairman. Aigis, bring Amada here.", "It's not your fault. If anyone should have realized it, it should have been me.", 'Akihiko ...', 'Yes, it has.', 'Amada ... are you able to fight?', "Alright, I'll talk to the Chairman. Get some rest.", 'I see. Then you must be busy.', "Well, I ... I guess you could say it's my way of atoning for the past.", '...', 'What are you trying to say?', "Maybe so, but at least then we'll be able to return to a normal school life.", "... Me? Yes, it was just me at first. Of course, back then SEES didn't exist, and this was just a regular dorm.", 'No ...', "One time, my father's research team was attacked by Shadows. That's when I awakened to my Persona ... when I witnessed the incident.", 'It seems I was the first.', "... I suppose that's true.", 'They know this is their last chance. Even though we were expecting this, we should be careful.', "You've all done a fine job up to this point. This will be our last operation; let's come back safely.", 'Different?', "Yes ... it's finally over ...", "You don't waste any time, do you? Well, I suppose I can arrange for it.", 'Yes.', "I don't know.", '...', "We're heading for Tartarus.", "I don't know, but that's where the sound is coming from. We have to find out what's going on.", "... What is your intention? It was all a lie, wasn't it? You knew from the beginning that the Dark Hour wouldn't disappear.", "That can't be.", 'You doctored it?!', 'He left that recording at the expense of his life.', 'But I ... I wanted him to live ... I ... became a Persona-user to protect him ...', '... Sorry about that.', "Hmph ... the class trip, huh ... even if I went, I'd only spoil the fun.", '...', 'Is that so?', 'Takeba ...', 'Takeba ... thank you for your concern. For now, I will attend to my duties.', 'Why are you still concerned about me? Our days of fighting together are over. We have no common goal to fight for, no enemies to defeat ... no reason to be friends.', "We've reached our conclusion. Why should we continnue on? Everything I believe in was a lie. And in the end, I failed to ...", "That's right! I fought to protect him, and look what happened! My trust for the Chairman blinded me, and I fell right into his trap! There was nothing I could do!", 'But my efforts were futile, and now my life is without meaning ... right?!', '...', 'Your father was only doing what he thought was best ...', 'Yes ... yes, I agree, Takeba.', 'Yukari, will you stand with me until the end?', 'T-take a bath together?', '... Nothing?', "What's the matter, Yukari? Did you hear something?", "Other Persona-users. They're outside Tartarus!", "She's speaking thruogh Yamagishi?!", "By the way, Arisato, I'd like to talk to you about something. If you don't mind, can you spare some time?", "... I thought it tasted strange at first, but as I continued to eat, I realized it had a subtle charm to it. It's quite delicious.", "This ramen tastes absolutely wonderful. ... It's been awhile since I last complimented the chef. What do you use for bouillon?", 'Now, this would be considered a meal if one were to eat it with rice, yes? That is very interesting.', "Oh, sorry. My imagination got the best of me. I've been wanting to try ramen for a long time ... does that make me strange?", "I felt extremely awkward coming here alone. I'm so glad you're here with me. You've taught me so much about ramen etiquette. Let's eat here again sometime.", "This came for you. it's from the hospital.", "Well, she hasn't sensed any of their members, but we can't be positive.", "Alright, call the others. Let's see what's going on here.", 'Yes, there are many questions we need answered. To begin with, you said Shadows were here to facilitate the rebirth of the maternal being ... please elaborate on this.', 'All life will vanish ... ? Th-then that must mean ...', 'The Fall ...', "... You're right. We humans are quite resilient. We can adapt to any situation, given enough time.", 'But either way, we still die, so there is no simple answer.', 'Then what do you want to do? Do you want to kill him?', 'Yes ...', "I must admit that I'm not very familiar with fast food etiquette ... I'm glad you're here with me. ... Is it profitable to sell these items at such a low price? I'd be interested to know the average cost per unit ...", "I wanted to express my personal thanks to you. We are all facing a trial in the true sense of the term ... and we've made it this far because we've been blessed with each other. I admit that I've been hard on you, much more so than the others, but I just wanted you to know ...", 'No, I just wanted to talk.', 'I have no idea ...', "Sometimes I'm amazed at my ignorance of the world ... what?! They don't accept credit cards?!", "Mmm ... it tastes slightly sour ... are there other ingredients in addition to the octopus? Well, whatever they may be, they taste absolutely delicious ... c'est tres bon!", "Don't you think Akihiko has been acting differently lately? I don't mean to be rude, it's just that I've known him for such a long time ... perhaps he's just maturing. With all we've been through, it can be difficult to get over our pasts. However, Akihiko is trying to learn from his experiences. I'm very impressed by him.", "Perhaps I feel pressed for time because I'm the only one of us who isn't growing ... let's just forget about this. ... Sorry for subjecting you to my incoherent ramblings.", "My inheritance ... the future of Kirijo ... and the expectations of everyone involved with both ... most likely I won't be able to attend college or begin a profession. I will have to find another path.", "... but as time passed, they slowly grew to love each other. I don't consider them unfortunate ... love comes in all different forms. Do you disagree?", "I'm not very good at romantic relationships, and besides, I don't have any spare time to devote to another.", "What's wrong, Aigis?", 'But we must still try.', 'I apologize for the sudden announcement. The reason I called you here is ...', "Chihiro ... I'd like to hear the whole story directly from you.", "From what I've seen in Student Council, Chihiro, it's obvious that you didn't take the money.", "I was just testing you. In a situation like this, I'm afraid you have to prove your innocence. Do you think you can do that?", 'Calm down, Fushimi!', "Don't worry. Even if you do forget about us, I'll remind you.", "It should be somewhere where it's easy to recognize that peace has returned to the city.", "Alright then, let's get going.", 'Yes it is.', "We don't have time for this. Get out of our way.", "The world isn't so simple that one person can decide whether we all live or we all die ... so even if these is hope, we won't give up.", 'When I first addressed you from this podium, I spoke to you all about seizing opportunity while you had the chance ... well, it must have been fate that intervened and gave me an important reminder of this. As many of you know, my father unexpectedly ...']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["Were you surprised to hear me bring up magic? It's a recent proposal, so it's not well-known yet ... here it is: those who believe will be saved. Study hard, and I can beat your weak minds into shape!", "Who can use magic, and who cannot? That'll be our starting point.", 'Pulling pranks on people, hurting your enemies ... if that\'s what you think, you\'ll never learn magic. It\'s true of both eastern and western sorcery ... those with wicked hearts with either be powerless, or driven to ruin. There\'s one more thing that can\'t be forgotten when learning magic. That is ... a "\'master". You should aspire to become as good as your predecessors, especially if you\'re studying difficult magic.', "When you begin your training, you'll have to live in two worlds at once: the real world, and the dark realm. If you can't distinguish between the two, you're headed for certain disaster. That is why the presence of a master is of the utmost importance! With that in mind, I'll move on to meditation, a standard practice in magical training ...", "We all need to start somewhere. Rome wasn't built in a day! The same goes for magic. It's important to learn the basics. So today, I'll tell you about the origins of magic. Long, long ago, at the dawn of civilization, man created primitive religions. Animism, totemism, and shamanism all fall into this category. You learned them in world history, right?", 'Shamans would fall into a trance state and act as the intermediary between worlds, but it counts as "magic", where humans can have the power of gods and spirits at their own hands. This shaman-style magical tradition would later be embraced by witches. Take the common European witch, for example. People today think witches derived their power from contracts with the devil, but that\'s just the image that Christianity imposed on them. The wtiches\' predecessors were more like maidens serving the gods. It was through prayer to those gods that they earned their powers.', 'That\'s how they originally awoke to magic. Originally, Europe was full of religions that worshipped a slew of various gods. They were generically called "paganism". And for your information, the celebrations of Christmas and Halloween have pagan backgrounds. Now then, paganism and Christianity have a tighter connection to one another than you\'d think. As the Roman Empire grew stronger, so did the population of Christians in the empire ...', "But today, we'll talk about the single most magical place and time. Today's topic is the magic of medieval Europe. There are a lot of materials pertaining to western magic, from books to folklore. We'll cover all of it, including the changes it's gone through. As I mentioned last time, European magic has its origins in paganism.", 'Some well-known examples are Kabbalah, the study of the mystical aspects of Jewish texts and Gnosticism, a Christian sect founded by Simon Magus the Sorcerer.', "The same was true of Islam's scientific advances, which surpassed Europe's at the time. Now, as for the circumstances of magic in this age ... it was an era where the rule of Christianity and the insight of the natural sciences collided. Magicians bravely reached up for a connection with the gods ...", 'Particularly the famous "grimoires." Grimoires are collections of a wide range of magical texts, and ...', "You must all be very curious students to be taking this course over the summer. I'm not really sure what to make of that, eeheehee. Well, let's talk about something interesting today. All you future magicians will want to pay close attention, eeheehee ...", "Originating in 15th century Europe as normal playing cards, tarot cards evolved into tools of divination. A variety of different versions of tarot card decks exist, including the Marseille and Rider decks ... but today, in respect of the great magician Crowley, we will be using the Thoth deck. First, let's talk about the composition of the deck ...", 'The Major Arcana feature a variety of illustrations on their faces. Beginning with "The Fool" and ending with "The World", they tell a story in numerical order that is a metaphor of an individual\'s journey through life. Each Major Arcana represents a stage on that journey, an exerpeience that one must incorporate to realize his oneness. They\'re all important, so let\'s take a look at each of the 22 cards, one by one.', "Now let's continue with our special summer study - The Truth Behind Magic.", 'I assume all of you have at least heard of Kabbalah, yes? It is known as the mystical study of the Hebrew scriptures, but ... as I have mentioned before, it has had a great impact on western sorcery. It has been said that to learn the secrets of magic, first you must truly understand Kabbalah. So, who was the person who formed this incredible ideology known as Kabbalah?', 'But in reality, it was formulated by a group of rabbis long, long ago. However, because it consists of such a complicated coded system ... Kabbalah did not become known to the western world until much later.', 'For example, there is "Gematria," the interpretation of text by replacing letters with the numbers they represent. There is "Notarikon," where you take a letter from each word to form another sentence or thought. There is also "Temurah," a method where letters of words are replaced, thereby giving the sentence a new meaning. All these different methods make it difficult to fully comprehend Kabbalah.', 'Most illustrations depict it as a chart shaped like a tree. The 10 stages represented by the Sefirot ... and the 22 paths connecting them represent the stages of Creation God formed from his own self, as well as the direction in which humanity should evolve. Where did we come from? Where are we going? These answers lie in the Sefirot.']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["I'll be teaching you about good old Japan all year. Some people say Classic Lit isn't relative to everyday life, but oh how they're wrong! Hey, are you all listening to me ... ?", "Hold on, Mitsuru. This isn't an interrogation. Natsuki, you don't have to say anything if you don't want to. You wouldn't want to give her the wrong idea.", 'I was thinking of the students, of course. You children may not understand, but we have to consider the future of everyone affected.', "It, it was in her best interest ... I wouldn't want her records to be stained by something like this. Her parents agree!", "I-I didn't ... I was just ...", "Don't you want to give your classmates a proper goodbye?"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['And don\'t forget to put "san" at the end. The world\'s not a forgiving place, kid. You gotta show other people respect.', "... Well, there's no Buddha in this world, so ... alright, kid. Stop lookin' at me like that and sit down.", "... How come you're always alone when I see ya? Don'tcha got any friends, kid?", 'Let\'s define a "friend" as ... someone you hold dear. True friendship is seen through the heart, kid, not the eyes ... people always want somethin\' in a relationship. They only really love themselves. You don\'t call someone who doesn\'t like you your friend, do ya? No, you don\'t ...', "Which means in this world, there's no one you can hold dear. At the end of the lonely road of love, kid, you're the only one left standin' there.", "What's the deal with your hair, kid? Is that what's in style nowadays? Doesn't it get in your eyes? My son kept his hair long too ... you should cut it. No, better yet, shave it all off ... smooth like me.", "I'm not taklin' about fashion here. I'm sayin' you'd be better off without your hair. Oh, sure, you're young and good-lookin' now, but just wait ...", "Just don't expect nothin'. Simple, eh? And that way you won't ever be disappointed. You're gonna lose your hair eventually, kid, so why bother with it now? Bald is beautiful. You just wake up in the mornin' and go. No fuss.", "Hey, are you alright, kid? Y'know, money-wise? High school kids don't have much money, do they? At least, I never gave much to my son.", 'Is there anything you want right now? Materialistic desire can lead to aspiration, but still ... when you get to be my age ... hmph, nevermind.', "So you never get to enjoy that better life you're working so hard to have. Quite a paradox, isn't it? Do you know what the average lifetime income of a white-collar worker is, including a retirement fund and an annual pension?", "Thanks to me you learned somethin' new today, eh kid? Now don't waste your life workin' all the time tryin' to get rich; just take life as it comes.", "Ugh, I'm in bad shape ... I completely forgot I have a memorial service to conduct ... reciting the Heart Sutra with a hangover, ugh. Before, no matter how much I drank, all I needed was a cold shower to snap outta it.Guess I'm gettin' old, heh ... it's times like these I wish I didn't live alone.", "If ya think about it, livin' alone's probably the best thing a person could do ... you don't hafta wait for someone else to get otuta the bathroom when ya need to go. My son took forever in there. Yeah, livin' alone is the way to achieve peace and serenity. All things visible are bound to change and disappear ... all things in this world are not singular. They're all smaller parts of a bigger picture. And yet, they're all different from each other. All things in this world are unique.", "No matter how hard you try to live your life right, someone else can always mess it up. All things are unique, yet they are not singular ... maybe you've messed up my life a bit, too. Heheheh ...", "Those folks downstairs, they're probably around your age, eh? It looks like they're havin' fun drinkin' and dancin', don't it? But if you look closely, their eyes say otherwise. I bet they come here to relieve stress, but I wonder if any one of 'em are actually enjoying themselves ... stress won't go away unless you can take care of its source. You can forget about it, but it'll always come back.", 'If those kids really wanna relax, we should switch the music to the Heart Sutra, and ...', "I have a son ... he's about the same age as those kids down there. He'll be 21 this year ... if he's still alive, that is.", "Well, it's not like I've got high hopes for the future anyways ... all things are unique, yet not singular. Oh, sorry kid, I'm done talkin'. Go home before it gets late, alright? ... I'll see ya later.", "Didn't Dad tell you not to do that, ehhh?", "I thought you got in an accident or somethin' ... don't make me worry like that. What the hell were ya doin' thish late?", 'Damn ... all this time, I thought you were ... I guess my eyesight is getting bad after all.', "I wonder if they felt the same way I did as I waited for you earlier ... my wife and son, it's been four years since they left ... I used to stay out past midnight, and when I got home, my wife and I would get into a big argument. Now when I go home, I don't know what do do with myself, so I just come here and drink every night.", "I get drunk to avoid facing my problems. So yeah, I guess you could say I'm runnin' away. ... She hasn't called me or sent me a letter since then. She must've gotten over me. Who knows where they are, or if they even wanna see me ... aw, forget it. It's too much of a hassle anyway.", "Anyway, I'm sober today ... so just sit down and listen to what this old monk has to say. All I gotta do is look all serious and recite the sutras, and I can make easy money; at least, that's what I thought. So I begged to take over my parents' temple. But every day is the anniversary of someone's death! I'm workin' 24/7, as if my temple was a convenience store ...", "It varies, of course, but an offering can sometimes be as much as a salary man's year-end bonus. But as you can see, I'm too busy. I gotta push this old body of mine to the limit. Maybe I should think of somethin' else to do with my life. I can't keep this up for much longer ... I've been drinkin' too much lately ... makin' a fool of myself like I did the other day. A person should know when enough is enough.", "We never filed for divorce, and since I own the temple, we could all live there. I think it's a pretty good idea. I could retire and enjoy life for once. Whaddya think?", "First, I gotta find out where they are. I'll hire a detective. I don't care how much it costs. And when I see 'em, first think I'm gonna do is tell 'em I'm sorry ... from the bottom of my heart. I'm gonna be concentratin' on this, so ... I probably won't be seein' ya anytime soon ... I-I've had enough of dealing with a punk like you, anyways! G-Good riddance!", "He said they're runnin' a small restaurant. I guess it's pretty popular. My son's married, and his wife's pregnant ... that makes me feel so old.", "I won't be back until they've forgiven me. I'll get down on my knees if I hafta. And if my son wants to sock me in the face, well, that's fine too. I-I've been thinkin' about what I'm gonna say to my wife ... even though I'm not so good with words ...", "But I finally faced the fact that I was drinkin' to hide my true feelings. I feel so free now.", "You reminded me of my son. Maybe Buddha sent you to help me ... I gotta admit, I believe in fate. If I hadn't met you, I'd never have seen my family again. I owe ya, kid ...", "Plus, it tastes sooo good goin' down. I'll be prayin' that your future is XYZ ...", "I don't got nothin' to say to anyone who doesn't have any booze.", "What're the employees here thinkin', lettin' you in? Well, since ya got me a drink, I'll pretend I'm your parent so ya don't get thrown outta here. ... Well? C'mon kid, sit down. havin' to look up at ya is strainin' my neck.", "Well, don't worry, in two or three more years you'll be old enough to hang out here unsupervised. Just take it easy, kid. You'll be legal before ya know it. No need to rush. Actin' like an adult only makes ya look more like a kid.", "Well, don't get your hopes up too high, kid. That way you won't be disappointed when things don't work out. Cuz then you'll hafta smoke and drink just to get through the day ... you're nothin' like those punks I see runnin' 'round town these days. Can't say the same for my son though, heh ... always bein' taken in by the police for questioning ...", "I told you not to come back here ... hmph, kids. Well, I don't care as long as you don't get on my nerves. Here, take a seat.", "... You jokin', kid? Heh, that's a good one. But watch your mouth, kid. You shouldn't be sayin' somethin' like that to an adult ...", "You don't have to revere me, but at least show me some respect."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["I-I never thought it'd turn out like this ... Fuuka ...", "She always looked so flustered when I gave her a hard time ... then I realized ... she's an honor student, but deep inside, she's the same as us. I knew exactly which buttons to push ... we were just messin' with her that day, too! May 29th ...", 'But she never came back ... and the next morning ...', "I went to the gym to let Fuuka out, but the door was still locked ... so I opened it and went inside, but she wasn't there. We all freaked out. Starting that night, we went out looking for her ... but every night, another one of us wound up missing ... and they each ended up like Maki!", 'A creepy voice ... right before each of them went missing. They said it was calling their name ...', "I'm all alone, after all ... Fuuka ... hm?", "I ... I have to go ... tell her I'm sorry ... Fuuka ...", 'Fuuka, you ...', 'Yeah ...', 'Fuuka, I ...', 'I heard you started living in the dorms.', 'You seem so depressed ...', 'You could probably use a friend, huh?', 'Oh, come on. Just call me Natsuki.', "Oh, you're going back to your home home today, huh? Okay, then never mind.", "Talk to me. Tell me what's bothering you.", "Oh ... pretty shocking, huh? I've never seen him at school, but I've seen him around town ... I wonder if he really did get caught up in some kind of crime.", "Parents, huh ... ? I can relate to that. But you'll be okay, right?", 'Yeah, yeah.', "It's not like telling you would've changed anything. Why make us both depressed? Anyway, my dad's pretty sick and they say it'll take some time for him to recover ... we don't really have that much money, so we can't afford to stay here. Y'know, I still think you're crazy for being friends with someone ilke me ... but like I said before, we're both in the same boat.", "That's why I was so jealous when you moved into the dorm.", "But Fuuka, your house is nearby and your parents are pretty normal. So why'd you move?", "If you don't wanna tell me, that's okay. But if it's something that you and your folks can work out, then do it while you have the chance. It'll be awhile before my dad's in any condition for us to have a heart-to-heart.", "Y'know, Fuuka ... I used to think that every day was just the same. And I'm only saying this because it's you, but you don't get any second chances in life. If you accept the way things are, then they'll never change.", "I won't be in school next week 'cause I'll be packing, so I guess this is goodbye.", "Haha, it's okay. Everything will be alright. C'mon, don't gimme that look ...", "Hey, I'm not helpless, y'know. I've changed a lot since I met you. I'm gonna try and figure out what I really want now, and I hope you do the same.", "Hahaha. That is so like you, Fuuka. Well I say if they don't accept you for who you are, then screw 'em. But I like you ... even if you don't like yourself."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['Teehee ... are you hitting on us?', "We were bored anyway, so why don't we just play along? Hey, you guys are kinda cute ...", "Wow, you made my day ... even though I know you're just trying to flatter us. To tell you the truth, we're older than that ...", "We don't even have anything to talk about ... except work, and that's just complaints.", "Come on, Yoshie, give him a break ... he said he's interested, right?", "Oh yeah, sorry. Did we forget to mention that? Well, gotta go. We're having a barbeque at the villa. You can come if you want."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["... What difference does it make what I'm eating? You wouldn't understand the artful construction of this limited edition gourmet sandwich. Besides, after I'm done with this, there's a restaurant I must visit. Ahhh, I'm sooo busy ...", "You're making me feel self-conscious! Agh! You've spoiled the moment! I can't savor the flavor of my limited edition gourmet sandwich with you here ...", "Oh, you're curious? Do you consider yourself a gourmet? Is that possible? A slim guy like you? ... Prove it.", 'Give me some time to think ... phew, I finally swallowed it. Now the quiz begins. This first question is a freebie.', 'Correct.', "Ahh ... you're pretty good.", "Bzzt, wrong, sorry. I don't feel like giving you a quiz anymore. Come back some other time.", "I'm impressed. You seem to have some knowledge about food. But it pales in comparison to mine! Let's see ... can you bring me something I've never eaten before? I doubt such a thing exists, though.", "G-give that to me! Ugh ... this is ... awful! But I'm impressed. I haven't tasted something like that in all my life.", "Um, I'm kind of embarassed to say this to you first thing, but..", "Wh-whoa ... it-it's you ... h-h-h-help! Uh, emergency! Call the fire truck, I mean the ...", "My name is Nozomi Suemitsu! By the way, about what I said before ... maybe it's not so bad having you stand in front of me.", 'You want to tag along? Do you know who I am?', "I know all the best places for ... uh, what? That ... sounds like a tummy emergency. This is gonna be tooe xpensive. I'll have to treat you another time. Don't worry, I'll remember!", "Then let's go to the Beef Bowl Shop. That's the place for you.", "They think they understand how I got this far, but they're wrong. The sooner they accept that, the better for them. Because of your corageous appetite, I will declare you as a supporter of the Gourmet King.", "It kind of feels like I have a younger brother now. So, how 'bout it? Do you want to have me as a big brother?"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["We've met before.", "I remembered, so I thought I should tell you. The end of everything. ... But to be honest, I don't really know what it is. Oh, looks like you've awakened to your power ... and an unusual power it is. A power that takes many forms, yet is bound by none ... it may prove to be your salvation, depending on where you end up.", "I'll be watching you, even if you forget about me ... okay then, see you later.", "You will enocunter one of THEM. You must prepare for the ordeal, but time is of the essence ... I'm sure you're aware of that, of course. I'll come see you again when it's over. Goodbye for now.", "I'm glad you remembered me.", "I told you, remember? I'm always with you ... but we don't have much time to talk. Tonight there is more than one ordeal you must face. You should hurry ... she's waiting for you. You guys will need her. Okay, then. I hope we can speak again ...", "It doesn't seem so certain, considering the vast potential within you. As a matter of fact, your seems to have changed quite a bit.", 'Oh, I see, I need a name ...', 'You may call me that if you wish.', "I'm already looking forward to our next meeting.", "You're used to it by now, huh? ... The next full moon will be in one week. Are you prepared ... ? Be careful, okay? I'll come again.", "So how's life as a Persona-user?", 'I remembered something else about the coming of the end ... it all goes back to an occurence that took place many years ago.', "Hey ... didn't your parents pass away about ten years ago?", "Which means a Persona-user can never escape from his true self. Regardless, I will stay with you ... because we're friends.", "So how are you getting along with the others? ... It is one week until the next full moon. Are you prepared ... ? To be hoenst, I'm not too worried about you. However, you should still remain cautious.", "The end won't be brought about by anyone in particular ... it's coming because there are so many people who wish for it ... as if it was destined from the start. But doesn't that seem like a strange thing to wish for?", "What about those who wish for an end to their suffering, who wish to find peace? Well, enough about that for now. There's something else I wanted to tell you today.", "I don't know whether or not this has anything to do with the end, but you should be careful. I'll come again if I find out anything useful. That's what friends are for, right?", 'Are you ready ... ? Only a few trials remain ... so be careful. I look forward to seeing you again.', "Time goes by so quickly, and many things change. Yet some things will always remain the same ... don't you agree?", "... That tower, for instance. I've been thinking about it lately ... I wonder ... will our relationship stay the same ... ? Or will it evolve? No matter what the future holds, you and I will be friends ... that is for certain.", "I hope nothing serious happens. But who knows what the future will bring ... so be careful. Remember, I'm always watching you ... we'll meet again.", "Can you believe it's already autumn? It'll be winter before you know it. You seem tired. Did something happen?", 'Until recently, this was the same to me as the blowing of the wind. But now I see things differently ... for the first time, I have a friend.', "It's drawing near. Don't you sense it ... ? We are kindred spirits, you and I, so why is it that only I can remember? This is a heartrending matter ...", 'Forgive me if I have said anything peculiar today. ... Perhaps it is the change of seasons. Of course, our friendship remains steadfast. Well, I shall bid you farewell for now. Goodnight ...', 'At last, the 12th one. Are you ready?', "But it's a bit soon to be reminiscing.", 'Be careful now ...', "All the fragments of my memory ... they've finally come together. I now know my role clearly. The time has come. As difficult as it may be, I must tell you something ...", "I want you to know that for me, our friendship was a miracle. But miracles don't last forever. If only they did ...", 'Even if today is the end, the bond between us can never be severed. Remember that.']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['There must be some handsome young man who will drive the housewives wild ...', "(But he's just a high school student. If I trained him, though ... ) Hello there, young man. How would you like to have your dreams come true? I have a golden opportunity for you. I'm only saying this to you, so don't tell anyone, okay? I can make you rich - guarunteed.", 'I have some unfortunate news regarding your investment. Things are not running as smoothly as planned. It still has the potential to turn a profit, but ... I would require an additional 10,000 Yen to get things back on track. Are you willing to increase your investment by this amount?', "I'll be in touch once your fortune has been made.", "We ran into a bit of a snag again. Some of the other investors decided to drop out ... since there's fewer investors, each person's profits will be even bigger! Do you mind investing a bit more? Just 10,000 Yen more. That should be plenty!", "Have you not yet realized that you are being decieved? Everything I've said has clearly been suspicious! ... Ignorance should be a crime. Sure, you have some positive qualities, but if you remain so naive, everyone will take advantage of you.", "That little brat! Doesn't he realize he's in the presence of a star?! I should have charged him extra for that autograph signing ...", 'D-did you overhear me talking to myself? You\'ll forget it ever happened if you know what\'s good for you. I belong to a powerful talent agency. I\'m practically a celebrity ... I have an image to maintain. Don\'t even think about telling someone "He took my money!" or "He called me a little brat!" Capiche?!', "Silly me! I've let you in on my secret, haven't I? Tee hee hee. Don't tell anyone, okay?! Please! I'll lick your shoes clean if you want me to!", "A verbal agreement is considered a contract, and I'll sue your pants off if you breach ours! I've got your adorable little face etched into my memory.", "You're a diamond in the rough, my boy. All you need is a little polishing and you'll sparkle. I usually take my breaks here. I'd be happy to mold your young mind whenever you wish.", "You should be glad you're such a handsome boy. Alright, let's add a new word to our vocabulary. Repeat after me!", 'A placebo is a "pretend" pill. Basically it\'s a medicine to ease your mind. Eliminate those unsightly lovehandles without lifting a finger! It\'s a miracle breakthrough that will make you feel fabulous! Enjoy a relaxing drive while taking in the beautiful scenery! Our incredible supplement will help you get the most out of life!', "We may not be providing tangible benefits, but we do provide peace of mind. People will pay handsomely for that, you know. Take emergency supplies, for example ... people feel safe just because they have them, but it's merely a false sense of security.", "If you put all your money in the bank, your modest gains will be offset by outrageous fees! Don't let the fear of bankruptcy dissuade you! You have to be aggressive in the management of your assets!", "Since our scales have been skyrocketing, we decided to sell shares. And guess what? The number of shareholders skyrocketed too. Listen, this is the funny part ... the majority of our shareholders are also our customers! They keep buying more of our products, so of course the stock will rise! Isn't that hysterical?! You should learn to appreciate the irony.", "Oops, I forgot. You're underage. If you're curious, go ask one of your friends ... but not a girl, unless you want to get slapped. Our company has introduced a special filter for digital cameras. Simply attach it to your camera and voila! Start peeping!", "It's been selling like hotcakes! In fact, it's our number one seller! Unfortunately, customers have been complaining that it doesn't work. I told my employees to just ignore them. Nowhere does it guaruntee that you'll be able to see anything, and it's not like anyone would actually admit they bought one.", "... Oh dear me. I-I just can't concentrate. I get so worked up when I picture his face!", "There was a young man who was working for me. He was a good kid who graduated from a well-known university, but this month he wasn't able to meet his sales quota, so I docked his pay. After that, his self-confidence went down the drain, then he just stopped coming to work.", "It's his fault that the company is in the red this month! All that money I wasted on training him ... it makes me sick just thinking about it. Well, he only worked with me for two years, so at least I won't have to provide a pension ...", "It's difficult growing up with no money, when you can't even afford shoes for PE class! Going barefoot in the gym during winter can be torture!", "Your innocent appearance would be perfect for camouflaging the ugly realities of business! Think about it, will you? You won't ever have to worry about being able to buy shoes for PE.", "I had to pay for transportation, membership renewal, and of course my hotel room. I doubt you'd understand how I feel, since you're still young, but a high school reunion is a very important event ... it's the perfect opportunity to show everyone else how pathetic their lives turned out.", "Now they both look at me with envy. Their annual salary doesn't even compare to my monthly income! My business is on a roll, and my private life is also very satisfying. Let me take you under my wing as our exclusive model.
