It's a once in a lifetime opportunity. Don't think I would extend this offer to just anyone.", "I had an appointment at the spa for a facial peel ... isn't my skin positively radiant now? I'm afraid it's all part of the job; I have my fans to think of. At home, I'm completely the opposite. I dress like a slob and only shower once every three days. Let me give you an analogy ...", "Imagine an organically grown cucumber that looks deformed. Compare that to a cucumber that looks perfect, but was grown using chemical fertilizers and pesticides. Awkward-shaped cucumbers are difficult to stack, so stores prefer nice straight ones. Taste and safety are not really considered; instead, they carry cucumbers that even mold won't eat. So why do consumers still buy those cucumbers when they know the truth?", "That's why, as much as I hate spending money, I buy expensive ties to win people's trust. ... Wait! You remember what I just said about me dressing up like a slob and not showering everyday ... don't tell ANYONE! I can't afford to have people start believing I'm ordinary! I only said it because it was you; you're the only one who knows.", 'He said "Thank you." He told me he quit his part time job and was going to study to become a public prosecutor; he wants to punish businessmen like me for bending the rules. He said I was an example of a negative role model. As if!', 'Lord knows what they would do to me in prison! ... Would you still come visit me if I was in the slammer?', 'But no matter how attractive she was, I was repulsed by her dedication to charity work. If I say no to donating, though, the tabloids will tear me to shreds ... why should I have to give my hard-earned money to a bunch of freeloaders?', "That's what I had always dreamt of, but to tell you the truth, now I have too much money. Profits are booming, but I'm so busy I don't have time to spend a dime. Maybe I should train someone to take my place.", 'I could create a carbon copy of me! It would probably cost me a fortune, but if it works then I could sit back and relax in my massage chair!', "Just kidding. People would think I'm a weirdo if I adopted a boy as old as you.", "I don't look at it as a donation so much as an investment. Let me explain ... children who learn to cope with adversity are more likely to become rich and famous, like me. I'm thinking of donation 10 million yen. Not a corporate donation, but a private one.", 'I received it the very next day. Now I can\'t back out ... 10 million yen is nothing to me, though. Once these children grow up and become successful, I\'ll introduce myself to them. I\'ll say, "I\'m the one who made all this possible!" Then I\'ll be well taken care of in my old age!', 'By talking to you, I seem to have developed an interest in watching others mature ... I thank you for that. Actually, I should be thanking myself for wisely noticing this.']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["Haha, rejected from the start. You're an interesting girl ...", "I've been looking everywhere for you!", "Huh? Same as you, I was trying to find Mitsuru-senpai. Some girl I've never met before asked me to look for her ...", "I wasn't the only one she asked, either. She said if we didn't find her, the class trip might get cancelled ...", "Hey, she didn't answer my question ...", 'I know this place on Shirakawa Boulevard ...', "Don't worry. This is simply a misunderstanding. We'll just act like we didn't know.", 'You know, in the hot spring ...', "You know, I'm here a lot, but I hardly ever run into you. Strange, huh? Oh well, I'm outta here. See ya.", "... Oh, that's right. You don't really like me, do you? Well, to answer your question, I ended up here when I came to my senses. It's strange ... the sky and the ground look so weird, and there's no one here ...", 'Forgotten what?', '...', 'Your enemy ... ?', 'Who ... who am I? Who are you?', "I remember everything now ... the frightening truth about myself ... and Shadows ... it's all so hard to believe ...", "Ten years ago, a man collected a great number of Shadows and contained them in a laboratory ... that's where I was born, but the unification was interrupted, and I awoke in an incomplete state. Not long after, I fell to Aigis ... as she did to me.", 'His special Persona awakened, as did the 12 Shadows, all in order to become one with me.', "Yeah, I'm okay, thanks.", '...', "You heard the bell ... I'm the Appriser ... the Appriser of Death ... my existence is the affirmation of the Fall.", 'So have you reached a decision?', 'Don\'t let the fact that you\'ll have to kill me influence your decision. As I said before, I\'m going to disappear anyways. I won\'t feel any pain by "dying", so there\'s no need to worry about me.', "... It's an unfortunate decision, but it's yours to make.", "But you can't defeat Nyx ... it's impossible.", "Nyx will descend to Tartarus and the world will end. If you go to the top of Tartarus on that day, you'll be able to face her. The tower exists for the purpose of Nyx's coming. As the Appriser, I usher Nyx into this world, and Tartarus welcomes her arrival.", "Yes, but remember: From today, you will fight against eternal despair. Like I've said so many times before, Nyx cannot be defeated."]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["I don't remember swearing a blood oath.", '... Wanna give it a try?', "You idiots! Get outta here! This place isn't for you.", 'You guys ... you were at the hospital ... did Aki tell you to come here? What do you wanna know? About that ghost story?', "It's a rumor.", "That's why people are saying it's Fuuka's spirit that did it. I hear it's all over the 'net, too.", "You guys don't know?", "She hasn't been home in over a week. Don't you guys go to school?! How do you not know this?", "That's all I know. Satisfied?", '... Huh?', 'Shut up. You always eat that protein shit.', '... Is that what this is about?', "I'm not interested.", "I made up my mind a long time ago. I ain't goin' back.", 'Face it ...', "Hmph ... why're you here? If you came here to try and convince me, then forget it.", 'Huh?', "Heh ... you haven't changed one bit. If you wanna get all sappy, go do it with your other friends.", "So obviously, there's something on your mind.", "Your reason for fighting, huh ... that's different for every person. But if you don't have a good one, you can always quit like I did.", 'Beats me.', '...', "Tch ... I don't know the details, but supposedly if you destroy all those creatures, then the tower will disappear, and with it the Dark Hour.", 'Y-yeah ... why?', "Tower of Demise ... ? Who wouldn't wanna take out that damn tower?", 'Makes no difference to me.', 'Do whatever you want ...', "Like I said before ... it doesn't concern me.", "Well, the answer's still the same: I'm not coming back.", '... What?', '...', '...', "It doesn't matter.", "What difference does it make if I come to terms with it? It won't change anything. This isn't the same as what happened to Miki.", "That's enough already. I just want to forget it ever happened.", 'What?', 'Yeah, so what?', "You've gotta be kidding me ... let me ask you one thing. Was it his decision to join SEES?", 'I see.', "So you're the one leading the operations now, huh? If you don't mind me asking, what exactly are you fighting for?", "Well, you do your thing; I'll do mine. Is my room still vacant?", "Don't worry ... I got your back.", 'We have enough to go on ...', '...', 'Tch ...', "We'll see.", "Wait a minute ... I overheard the manager of Escapade saying that the power's been acting up lately.", 'Relax ... it happens.', "You'd be surprised what you can learn on the streets. I'll give the doc the right pills. The rest is up to you ...", "I don't owe you anything.", "Save it. I've heard it all before. You think I'm wasting my power ... but you're just too thickheaded. I'm tired of your damn preaching.", '...', "I'm back in the fight now ... so let it go.", "It's something only I can do.", "... Listen, don't worry about me. Just do what you think is right.", '...', '...', "You're right ... I wanted to forget. That's why I left the group and tried to suppress my power ... but nothing I did could erase the memory. And now I find myself here - the last place I want to be.", "It's my fault ... this is what I deserve.", 'Just remember that ...', "Even if all you have now is hatred, one day you'll regret it.", '...', "That's bullshit!", "Th-there's no one ...", 'Ken ... no!']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["I apologize about the confusion regarding your accommodations. However, it may take a while longer before you receive the proper room assignment. Is there anything you'd like to ask?", "To welcome you, of course! Well, to be honest, I do have other business here. Speaking of which ... where's Mitsuru, Yukari?", "As dilligent as always. Although it doesn't hurt to come down and say hello ... is there anything else?", 'There are only four students in this dorm: Yourself, Yukari here, Mitsuru, and a senior named Akihiko Sanada. I hope you all get along.', "So, how's he doing?", "Well, let's wait and see for now ... the Dark Hour is approaching.", "As you can see, he's retained his human form. He's asleep, but he's definitely experiencing the Dark Hour. The only question that remains or not is whether he has the Potential. Although, he must ... if he didn't, they would've preyed on him by now.", 'In any case, we should continue to monitor him for a few more days.', "Hmm, very interesting ... even those who have the Potential tend to be unstable at first. Memory loss, disorientation ... but this subject is rather unique. He hasn't exhibited any of the common symptoms.", "I understand your concern, but it's imperative that we recruit new members. I heard he's your classmate ... wouldn't you be more comfortable working with someone from the same grade?", "I'm glad that you're okay. The reason I asked you here is because I needed to talk to you. Please, have a seat.", 'I believe I mentioned him earlier, but this is Akihiko.', 'Okay, let me start off by asking you this ...', "It occurs each night, as the clock strikes twelve. It'll happen tonight, and every night to come.", 'Now, now. He does his work well. Long story short ...', "Mitsuru is the leader. I'm the club advisor.", 'Some may even awaken to a power that enables them to fight the Shadows. That\'s "Persona", the power you used the other night. The Shadows can only be defeated by Persona-users ... which means it\'s all up to you guys.', "Thank you so much. I'm really glad. Oh, I almost forgot, about your room assignment ... why don't you just stay here, in your current room? I don't know what the holdup is, but I guess it worked out in the end.", "I'd like your undivided attention. For a long time, Mitsuru and Akihiko were the only Persona-users we had. But that number has recently jumped to five. Therefore ...", "It's no surprise, since it only appears during the Dark Hour.", "Well, I'm sure he won't complain, as long as you don't go too far in. Since we're dealing with Shadows, Tartarus isn't something we can avoid.", "I'll stay here. As you know, I can't summon a Persona ...", "When I heard they'd hijacked a monorail, I feared the worst. Well done. Now I don't have to worry about tomorrow's headlines.", "I'll be looking into the matter.", "Hmm ... let's not jump to any conclusions. For now, we should study their behavior for patterns or clues. We cannot always afford for them to make the first move.", "Don't be so hard on yourself, you're doing fine. More importantly ...", 'Everyone, you did an excellent job uncovering the truth. I also wanted to let you know that the three girls have regained consciousness.', 'From what I understand, they each came to school around midnight and waited for the security guard to leave. They were attacked by Shadows near the gate, as the Dark Hour began. However, the facts became twisted because of rumors concerning a ghost story.', "We still don't know where they're coming from, but Akihiko is right about one thing ... their appearances seem to coincide with the full moon. We'll take that into consideration from now on.", 'I want you to listen closely; it might be hard to follow.', "We've known this for awhile. It's like their class or order.", 'Oh, sorry. Ahem ... those four Shadows belong to Categories I through IV, in order of their appearance! They may have looked different from the more common ones, but the classification scheme still applies.', "That's exactly right, Fuuka! You're quite sharp.", "That's a good question, and that's what we haven't figured out yet: their motive. They don't kill their prey; they feed on their minds. It can be considered predation, but is it really? Is there a more underlying intent behind their behavior? The purpose of the Shadows as a whole ... that's what we need to consider.", 'Or so it would seem.', "They've been finding the Lost in pairs lately ... now I understand why.", "The rooms are a bit fancier, that's all.", "It's okay. It's not your fault.", "And they lost their lives as a result of what they did ... we're all in the same boat here. None of us deserve the burden that's been thrust upon us.", "But since they're active, at least we can find and destroy them ... do you realize what this means?", "Exactly! That's what I was going to tell you earlier. See, it's good news, isn't it?", "There's evidence to support it.", "Regardless of what's happened in the past, we must fight to protect the people. The Shadows are gaining strength ... we can't afford to just wait for them. And there are many mysteries still surrounding Tartarus.", "I happened to be in the area, so I thought I'd drop by and tell you my schedule for next week.", "You'll all have some time off after exams, right? Why don't you go and pay him a surprise visit?", 'How about it, Mitsuru?', "Haha, don't worry ... no father would be upset with a daughter who came all that way to see him. You've all done a great job. You deserve to relax for awhile. We already know when the next operation will be, so it should be fine.", 'Adolescence is such a wonderful thing! So full of vibrancy!', 'I might as well introduce you to him now.', "He doesn't leave during the break because of his ... circumstances.", "Right now, one of his distant relatives is paying for his school expenses. But staying at the elementary school dorm all by himself isn't proper for a child his age. So I decided to move him to your dorm for the summer.", "Yes. But as you can see, he's still just an elementary school student. So it is merely a possibility for now.", "Well, I'm at the lab here on the island ... and a machine that was considered inoperable suddenly left the facility on its own ...", "I see ... well, regardless, I want you to handle this as soon as possible. I'm on my way there now.", "Just do your best. I'll call you again later.", "Oh, that's been taken care of. Come here, Aigis.", "Aigis was the last to be made ... and she's the only one that still remains today.", "It's still unclear as to why she suddenly reactivated herself this morning. Well, I hope you will all get along.", "Or maybe she's still half asleep ... this is quite interesting. Hmm ... well, I can ponder this later. Oh, I forgot to tell you all ... you can participate in a wide range of recreational activities here. There's a tennis court, a pool table, even a karaoke machine. Would you care to hear me sing?", "We've been quite busy during our time here, but it looks as if we can relax a bit today. I'm glad to see everyone is having so much fun. I've already told you what time the ship will be arriving tomorrow, yes? I'll most likely head over to the port early, so don't be late.", 'Until then, enjoy the last day of your vacation.', "So the plan was to place a human mind inside an anti-Shadow weapon ... the only real issue was the form the weapon would take. If the form of the weapon was a tank, for instance, the weapon's mind would recognize itself as a tank ... however, a tank is not a living entity. This is crucial, you see, because the mind of a non-living entity will not process human thoughts correctly ... so it will not function properly, and it will soon become corrupted. However, a mind placed inside a form that closely resembles a human body will recognize itself as a human being, thus allowing it to easily adapt to human thoughts. Therefore, Aigis and her sisters were built in the form of human beings.", "Well, there were many created. You could say they were Aigis' sisters. However, they were all destroyed ten years ago in the incident. Aigis has been quite lonely since then.", 'Perhaps it is simply a glitch in her human recognition programming ... regardless, it is nothing to concern yourself with.', "Well, the architectural and geographic data for the area were uploaded into her memory bank. Then again, the information hasn't been updated in a decade.", 'Good work. You may return.', 'A Persona-user?!', 'Hmm ... did they say anything that might give us a clue?', "Strega ... ? I'll see what I can find out.", "Ah, I see. Since the threat has been eliminated, I'll send someone over as soon as I can.", "I called this meeting so that I could introduce him, since he'll be joining our squad.", 'Besides ... what? His ability is quite promising. With the proper training, he could be a big help.', 'So as you can see, it was his own decision.', "You're all young; sometimes you just get in one of those moods. Anyway, we should focus on the task at hand.", "If even Fuuka couldn't sense her, then she must have some sort of power to conceal her presence. I didn't have the slightest clue she was here ...", "This will be the 10th ... only a few left, but let's worry about them one at a time.", 'Unfortunately, your realization has come too late.', 'The 12 Shadows were parts of a whole ... they were destined to be reuinted, and that was accomplished in no small part thanks to your efforts.', 'The end shall come and free this world from despair ... the death of everything ... but also the beginning ...', "The experiment went awry, but that is not why the Dark Hour and Tartarus were born. They manifested as a result of harvesting the Shadows' power ... just as the experiment was designed to do.", 'People have filled the world, yet turned it into a void! The only hope of salvation lies in ruin!', 'The man who tried it ten years ago failed, but I will not. I will succeed!', 'I apologize for deceiving you, but this was for your sake as well. If you follow me just a little while longer, you, too, will find salvation.', 'Yes?', "I CORRECTED it. Your father was a superb scientist ... he may not have known it, but I truly respected him. While others focused on the Shadows' abilities, he explored much more important things ... but unfortunately, he could not comprehend the magnificent potential of the Fall.", '"Used" is such an ugly word ... it was for the sake of the world, so how could it be wrong?', "... but you are just children, after all. I suppose it can't be helped.", 'It is just as it appears ... they are to be sacrifices, harbingers of the Fall. The arrangements are complete; the prophecy shall be fulfilled.', 'Of course not. ... You know, your father was an unlucky man. Even you, his son, after all this time do not understand his vision.', 'Fool! You are but a nuisance now! Aigis!', "Ten years ... I've waited ten ... long ... YEARS!"]

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['Truth be told, we all visit this world every night.', "Your notion of right and wrong is irrelevant. My client's wishes are all that matter. People hear what they choose to hear, and believe what they choose to believe.", "If there's nothing else ... I'm feeling rather tired.", "That was quite a show. They've been rather busy these last few months, including their frequent forays into the tower. Their fighting style is positively fascinating ... and it seems they've gained new recruits, too.", "Yes ... that's an excellent idea. Considering that he shares our fate, it would be prudent to seek his opinion. We don't have much time left ...", "They're like back alley rats.", "Your acquaintances have been busy lately. I'm referring to their activities on nights when the moon is full. They've spent a great deal of time in the tower as well. Why did they take this burden upon themselves?", "You do know, don't you? But you don't wish to say ... is it because they are your friends?", 'Then tell us.', 'Why would they do such a thing?! With the power they have ...', "... Well, I suppose it's more of a pet than an ally.", 'It seems like what you told us before about their intentions was true. How lamentable ... now we have no choice but to intervene.', 'But to erase the Dark Hour would be denying the very power they possess. We cannot tolerate that.', 'My name is Takaya. This is Jin.', 'We\'ve been keeping an eye on you ... from what we hear, you\'ve undertaken a "righteous" battle to save the world. But we\'ve come here tonight to put an end to that dream.', 'Tartarus is towering as beautifully as always ...', "Why don't you use that pretty little head of yours for a change? Only a select few wield the power of a Persona ...", 'What difference does it make ... ? There will always be disasters,w hether they are caused by Shadows or arise from human folly. No one can predict the future, anyway. But that is all beside the point ...', 'Is it not so? How about the rest of you ... ? Do you also wish to return to your pathetic, ordinary lives?', 'That is the nature of revenge. Is it not permissible to kill those who are themselves killers?', 'The loss of Chidori has posed a bit of a challenge for us ... but we cannot simply ignore your meddling.', 'You cannot defy fate ... you shall die, whether or not it is at the hand of this boy.', "You don't have much longer.", 'The cause of death is not of importance. Besides, the breath of life is faint in you as well, child.', "A slight change in timing shouldn't matter too much.", 'Now then ... with what life you have left, answer me this ... there is one like Chidori among you, is there not? This has enabled you to locate and defeat those we wish to protect. Now tell me ... which one of you is it?', 'Is that true?', "You claim to hunt the Shadows to prevent the disaster they bring, yet countless lives are lost every day without their intervention. The power we wield is not itself evil ... you cannot deny that. So why don't you just admit it? You do not wish to eliminate the Dark Hour ...", 'Erasing the Dark Hour is the same as erasing yourselves. Tch ... is even that beyond your comprehension? As I believed, our goals are irreconcilable.', 'Fate shall decide who shall prevail.', "Now, then ... ordinary we'd withdraw, but not tonight. This body, as ephemeral as it is ... it is worthless without my power. Therefore, only one choice remains..I shall prove my existence here and now!", 'Jin?!', 'Jin. The instruments, if you would.', '... Excellent.', "Chidori ... I see that it is too late. You've been poisoned by them ...", "I am no ghost ... fate permitted me to live, even though I wasn't attached to life ... you might say I was chosen.", 'Wh-what is the meaning of this?! Release me!', 'I take it you have defeated Jin ... you are quite troublesome. What is it that you seek? These are your final moments ... the end is nigh.', 'You are merely wasting your energy ... why not celebrate this wonderful moment?', 'There are many who have also gathered to rejoice in her arrival.', 'That ... is untrue.', 'Men cannot face death without first finding meaning in life ... but the world has realized that any meaning in life was lost long ago. Nyx has come because humanity has cried out for salvation!', '... What a peculiar question. You know nothing of death if you think that it is something to fear ...', 'You fear it because you do not understand it ... I will not explain it to you any further.', 'Hahaha ... you are all so odd ...']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['I heard you told them about the incident. Why did you hide it so long?', "I've told you time and time again; none of the blame is yours.", 'You must learn to trust in others, Mitsuru. There are things in this world that cannot be accomplished alone, no matter how many sacrifices you make.', "You accessed our database, didn't you? That's another thing ... why didn't you ask me directly, instead of using this trip as an excuse?", "There's a girl named Takeba in your group, correct? For her to awaken to her power ... it must be fate ...", "If I could've atoned with it for my life, I would have done so ... now I have no choice but to rely on you.", 'Imagine if you could control the flow of time ... eliminate unwanted events before they occur. With such a device, you could shape the future to your liking.', "In his later years, my father seemed to have only nihilism in his heart. Now that I think about it, his madness may have resulted from his struggle to break free from that ... it's only natural that you want to know the truth, and it's my duty to tell you.", 'But we are the ones who are responsible. We pushed him to continue the research.', "Congratulations, everyone. You've done well. There are no words to express my gratitude. Though you will never recieve the recognition you deserve, it is undoubtedly a monumental achievement.", '... For lending us your power until the very end.', "The twelve Shadows that were the cause of all our troubles have been destroyed, thanks to your efforts. You needn't bear this burden any longer; you deserve a chance to experience the joys of youth.", 'No longer must you put your lives on the line in battle. Tomorrow, you can triumphantly return to a normal school life.', "Well?! Why is he late?! He's got Aigis with him, doesn't he?!", 'You traitor! Are you insane?!', 'My father was wrong. Death as deliverance ... that is not an ideology that anyone should ever embrace!']

Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ["Who's he?", '... Is it okay for him to be here?', 'Nice to meet you, too ...', "Oh ... I'll show you the way. Follow me.", "Pretty easy to remember, huh? ... Since it's right at the end of the hall. Oh yeah, make sure you don't lose your key, or you'll never hear the end of it ...", "You know what I-- ... nevermind. It seems like you're alright. Well, I'd better get going ... um ... I'm sure you have other questions, but let's save them for later, okay? Good night.", "Mitsuru-senpai asked me to take you to school. It's getting late, so are you ready to go?", 'You should go see your homeroom teacher first. The Faculty Office is right there to the left ... and that concludes the tour. Do you have any questions before I go?', "Me? I dunno ... I haven't looked at the classroom assignments yet. Hey ... about last night, don't tell anyone what you saw, okay? ... See ya later!", "At it again, huh? I swear, you'll talk to anyone if they'll listen. Did you ever think you might be bothering someone?", "If you say so. Anyway, looks like we're in the same homeroom. Funny, huh?", "Wh-what are you talking about?! We live in the same dorm. There's nothing going on, okay?! Why are people even talking about it?! Now you have me worried ...", "Seriously, don't say anything about last night, alright?", "W-wait a minute! Don't get the wrong idea! Listen! I just met him yesterday, and there's absolutely nothing between us! Geez ... I've gotta go. I've got something to take care of for the archery team. But you better not start any rumors!", "She's upstairs.", 'Then, he must be ...', 'Scary ...', 'I feel kinda bad though, spying on him like this ...', "But ... we're treating him like a guinea pig.", 'Yeah, I guess, but still ...', "Does that mean ... he's bringing that thing here?!", 'But what about you two?', "Hurry! Downstairs! We'll leave through the back door! ... Wait! Take this, just in case.", 'Y-yes! I hear you!', 'What?!', "Thank goodnes, you finally came to ... how much sleep do you need?! It's been a whole week!", "Oh yeah, this is Tatsumi Memorial Hospital. It's just a short walk from the station. The doctor couldn't find anything wrong with you. He said you were just exhausted. But you kept sleeping and sleeping ... you know how worried I was? Um ...", 'Even though I was supposed to protect you, I ... but your power, it was amazing.', "We'll explain everything later. I'm sorry I didn't tell you before ... I, uh ... I wanted to tell you that ... I'm sorta like you.", "Hey, sorry to hit you with this first thing in the morning, but Ikutsuki-san wants to talk to you today. Come to the 4th floor of the dorm after school today, okay? Don't forget.", 'Welcome aboard!', "Holdup? But wasn't that ... oh, nevermind. It doesn't matter anymore.", "Wait, don't tell me ...", "He's staying HERE? You've gotta be kidding me!", 'You have the Potential?! For real?!', 'Huh? Uh ... y-yeah ...', 'I hope so.', "She's probably busy with things like Student Council, unlike us.", "Well, it's not that I don't like her ... she just ...", "You haven't seen it, Junpei?", 'But, Senpai ... what about your injury?', "I'm sure it's complicated. Who cares, anyway? it's not like it would change our minds about fighting.", 'But it sure is creepy ...', 'What?! By ourselves?!', 'But he HAS fought them before ...', 'I think so ...', "I'm aware of that.", "Cut him some slack. If nothing's wrong, let's get going.", "I hope I don't get lost ...", 'Well, THAT makes me feel a whole lot better ...', 'Got it. ... Why is she always like that?', "That's cuz you were bouncin' around like a little kid.", "I'm still trying to catch my breath, actually ...", 'Well, I guess she IS the most popular girl in school.', 'Yeah, I try not to think about that.', "Oh yeah? That's cool. ... You seem pretty talented, so I'm not surprised. Oh, by the way, maybe we should go to Tartarus tonight. With all the Lost, I think we should be doing anything we can to help. Plus, I didn't have practice today, so I could use the exercise.", "I'm aware of that.", "... You think it's about the recent incidents?", 'I know. His speeches always drag ...', "Well, it IS May already. It's amazing how time flies. So much has been happening ... ya know, it doesn't seem like the number of Apathy Syndrome cases has been decreasing lately ... we're the only ones who can fight the Shadows, so ... I guess if we train more, we'll be ready if anything like THAT comes up again. Me especially, I don't wanna be a burden on anyone else.", "He only asked you cuz you don't have anything else to do after school ...", "I'm just kidding! What'd he want you to bring?", "What's he want that for? Well, I don't have practice today, so I'll go with you.", "We came to see you! But ... it doesn't look like anything's wrong with you.", 'By the way, why boxing?', 'Yeah, VIDEO games.', "Yes, I can hear you clearly. We just got here, but I don't see anything out of the ordinary.", "Huh? Wait a minute ... we're not at a station, but the doors are wide ...", "It looks like we're trapped inside ...", 'R-roger!', 'Dammit, Stupei! What are you thinking?!', "He should know it's too dangerous to go alone ... don't you think he's acting weird? Did you say something to upset him, Minato-kun? Well, we can ask once we've caught up to him.", "See! That's what happens when you don't listen! So are you alright?", 'Excuse me?!', 'Whaddaya mean, "it seems"?!', 'What?! Oh god, what are we gonna do?!', "We're gaining speed?!", "We're going too fast! We have to put on the brakes or else ... !", 'I think so ...', "Um, y-yeah, we're okay ... ha ... my knees are still shaking ...", 'But how did you know which one was the brake?', 'You saved me again ... thanks.', "Junpei looks like the world is about to end. Well, exam scores will be posted today, so ... he said he's gonna beg for a higher score ... like that's gonna work.", "I hear she's kinda weak ... but that's just a rumor. I wonder what she's really like. Either way, having another Persona-user can't be a bad thing!", "My grades were pretty good ... I'm glad the exams were easy. Going to Tartarus wears me out, so I can't focus on my studies like I used to.", "Huh? Does that mean that no matter how many Shadows we defeat, more will just keep coming? If that's the case, then what's the point of fighting?", "I guess you're right. Ya know, it's kinda creepy when you think about it ... if we couldn't use our Personas, then the whole city would be crawling with zombies ...", "H-hey! C'mon ... nobody believes that stuff..right?!", "Wha?! It's probably made up ... so why bother?!", 'Uh ...', "Hey, watch it! F-fine, then let's investigate. We'll each ask around for the rest of the week. I'll prove to you that this ghost story is just an urban legend!", "Ya know what? From this day forward, I'm gonna do my best!", "Duh! The ghost story! Did you already forget what we talked about last night? ... You're hopeless. You better find out as much as you can, too. Remember, you only have until Friday! I'm counting on you, Minato-kun.", "This sucks ... I spent so much time thinking about ghost stories that now I'm having nightmares ...", 'Did you two ask around like we said?', "Then we'll meet in the lounge after school. Don't forget!", 'Of course! I got lots of good info. It turns out no angry ghost was involved.', "Hmph. First off, let's talk about how this rumor got started ...", 'But why did the rumor spread so fast if this was the first time anything happened?', "But yeah, I was surprised when I found out the reason ... over the next few days, there were two more similar incidents. All three victims had to be hospitalized. No wonder people were talking. Next ... the victims are in different classes, and they don't seem to be connected.", "They got in with a bad crown, and were always out late. It can't be just a coincidence ... so to find out what happened, we're gonna do some field research.", "Yeah, there's this one place where the three victims were regulars.", "Oh, you're familiar with it?", "Is that so? Well then, we should all go together. You'll come, right Minato?", "Up until now, all we've done is take orders. Does that feel right to you?", "Okay, we'll go tomorrow night then.", "It's easy to get freaked out by something you can't see, don'tcha think?", 'Big deal, so it\'s a little "dangerous" ... come no, it\'ll be an adventure!', "We don't need your permission to be here.", "I'm not blind, ya know. Come on, don't be intimidated by these scum!", 'Wait! We came here for a reason!', "Um, yeah ... how'd you know?", "Fuuka's spirit? Wait, what do you mean by that?", 'So much for the ghost story. Mr. Ekoda is the homeroom teacher for 2-E, right? Does he know about this ... ?', "Thanks! You totally helped us out. You're very kind.", 'Um ... nevermind.', "Wait ... you're that girl ...", 'She was found lying on the ground by the gate ...', 'Senpai, could it be?!', "Then ever since Fuuka got locked in the gym, she's been stuck there?", 'Now that you mention it ...', "That's true ... and even if she's still alive, we might not be able to get to her.", 'Is that really gonna work ... ?', 'Senpai ... ?', "I agree. And we won't know until we try.", 'I guess we can handle it ourselves.', 'Is that really something to brag about?', "What's the big deal, anyway?", 'No! ... Stupei.', "I don't like sneaking around ...", 'Sure did.', 'You wanna make something of it?!', 'Oh, come on! It\'s not always about you! Besides, you didn\'t "accidentally" screw up.', "Um, n-no, it's fine.", "... O-oh yeah, that girl Natsuki ... I hope she's okay at the dorm ...", 'Yeah, I guess so ...', "... Is he out of range? I'm starting to get worried ...", 'Um, what are we gonna do about Natsuki? She saw the Dark Hour, and the Shadows ...', "But that means she'll forget Fuuka saved her life, right? That doesn't seem fair ...", "Do you think Mitsuru-senpai saved Fuuka because it was the right thing to do, or was it just because she's a Persona-user and we need her? Well, whether or not she joins us is up to her ... sorry to bring this up out of the blue.", "Mitsuru-senpai and Akihiko-senpai are going to the hospital to see Fuuka today. I wonder how she's doing ...", "Hey, don't just assume that she'll be joining us ... I hope they're not trying to push her into it.", 'Are you kidding? You were the victim!', "Hey, don't think like that.", "You know, we're not trying to pressure you, so if you need some time to think about it ...", "A-are you sure?! If you join, you'll have to live here ...", "Wait a minute, aren't we dragging her into this a bit fast?", '...', 'Hey, Minato-kun ... what do you think about Fuuka?', "Doesn't it seem like she was kind of forced into joining us? I hope she'll be okay ...", "Don't you think she sort of pushed Fuuka into joining? I know it's nice to have her around, especially in battle, but ... it just feels wrong.", 'Whaddya mean?', 'And ... ?', 'What about Tartarus? Why does it even exist ... ?', "The night before last ... the twelve Shadows ... Tartarus ... isn't there just too much we don't understand? It's starting to get to me ...", "Ya know, in about a week, there'll be another mission ... I wonder what it'll be like this time? I guess we'll have to keep fighting until we defeat all 8 that are left. But ... what are we gonna do after that? I've been thinking about this for a while. I wonder if Mitsuru-senpai is hiding something from us ...", 'Well, um ... I was hoping you could do me a favor with your skill.', 'They were reported as absent, but I found some records that suggest it was something serious. Do you know anything about it, Fuuka?', "I know it was a long time ago, but ... doesn't it seem suspicious to you? From what I've heard, this isn't the first time Shadows have appeared.", "I don't know, but I wonder ... and I'm not trying to make trouble, but ...", "I just wanna know what happened back then. If it doesn't have anything to do with the Shadows, then fine.", "I've heard about it, but ...", "I don't know about this ... maybe I shouldn't go ...", "Wh-whatever! Fine. Let's go. But this time, I want a piece of the action! So who's gonna take the lead?", 'No! Nothing!', "Let's go!", 'I remember this one mirror we saw on the third floor was different from the others ... when I stood in front of it, I felt kinda strange.', 'You found out something? Cool, tell me later. Alright, we should head back too.', "Hey, why do you have to be like that? Don't tell me you're jealous.", "I'm sorry.", "Since I joined, so many things have happened ... I went along with it without really understanding what was going on, but now I need to know. I'm gonna ask you straight out ...", "You act like you don't know anything about the Dark Hour and Tartarus ... but they're related to that accident ten years ago, aren't they?", "There was an explosion near our school, and a lot of people died ... it must have been big news back then. You know about it, don't you?", 'Luckily, no students were injured. But around the same time, a large number of students were recorded as absent. Seems like more than just a coincidence.', 'I dug up some old school records and found something interesting. The students who were absent ... they all collapsed suddenly and had to be hospitalized. Sound familiar?', 'There has to be an explanation! What really happened on the day of that accident? The Kirijo Group built our school, so you must know something!', 'What ... ?', 'Wait a minute ... if what you said is true, then why did our school turn into Tartarus?', 'Then ... those students who were hospitalized ...', '... Does that mean ...', 'You lied to us?!', "You knew too, didn't you, Akihiko-senpai?! They've just been using us! Or do you not care as long as you get to fight?!", 'How could you ... ?!', 'But ...', '...', 'Am I stupid to beleive in things like trust and friendship ... ? Dad ... this old letter of yours ...', '...', "I won't turn my back. I won't be like Mom. Not ever ...", 'Ugh, men ...', 'Uh ... sorry about the other day ... I got a little carried away.', 'There is?', "So how'd you do?", 'Well, that pretty much answers that question.', "Oh yeah, that's coming up soon, isn't it? Are ya ready?", "I guess I should be more enthusiastic, huh? Hey, I don't have practice today, so do you wanna do something?", "As if! alright, gimme a sec, I'm gonna go grab my stuff from the locker room. Oh, I'll invite Fuuka, too.", 'Does that mean another person is going to join?', 'Mr. Chairman!', "Oh, hi, Ken-kun. What's up?", 'Oh, I heard about that ... something about his parents.', "Aren't you getting a little carried away? I mean, the trip is only for a few days, and we'll still have to fight Shadows over summer break. In other words, we can't afford to stop training in Tartarus.", 'Um, is this the right place?', 'What, already? I mean sure, but let me get changed first!', 'Stop that creepy laugh, you perv!', '...', 'So that means ... my dad caused it all ... ? The Dark Hour, Tartarus ... the people who died in that incident ... it was all his fault ... ?', "So that's why you were hiding this ... ?", 'This is too much ... remember what I told you at the hospital? How my dad died when I was little ... ?', 'Nobody knew the truth, so there were all sorts of rumors ... because he was in charge of the research team, people were really mean to me and my mom. We even had to move a few times.', "But all this time, I kept telling myself it wasn't his fault. I loved him a lot, and I believed he'd never do anything wrong. I recieved a letter back in the spring ... it was from him, written ten years ago.", "That only made me believe in him more ... when I found I had a special power, I thought it was fate. I was scared, but I thought if I cooperated with the Kirijo Group, I might find out what really happened. That's why I agreed to fight using my Persona.", "Why does reality have to be so harsh? I tried to fight my fear, and this is what I get ... maybe I'm just jealous of Mitsuru-senpai. I mean, why my father and not hers?", "Nothing ever fazes you. And now, you've got the nerve to try and tell me how to feel?!", "I'm sorry ... my head's a mess. I'm so afraid ... I don't know what to do anymore. I'm totally lost ...", 'Ya know ... you really are one-of-a-kind.', 'Anyway, thanks for listening.', "Huh? Oh yeah, that's right ...", "I-I almost forgot ... it doesn't matter where you are when the dark hour comes.", 'Once you awaken to the power of Persona, you remember everything that happens during the Dark Hour ...', "So I guess I'm stuck with you guys, huh?", '... Oh, yeah ...', 'A machine ... ?', 'A combat vehicle ... ? You mean like a tank?!', 'Geez! Where could they be?!', "You have no idea what we've--huh?!", "No way ... it's like she's ... alive.", 'Um, by the way ... when I saw you earlier, Aigis, it seemed like you knew him ...', "Oh, I'm sure she's waterproof.", 'Wow, you must really be bored.', "Whatever. We just have to defeat those last six, and it'll all be over. The Lost will get better, and everything will be back to normal, right?", "That girl disappeared, and we can't find her anywhere. Think you can help us out? She might've gone out on her own, like she did in Yakushima.", 'Huh ... ?', "That's unlawful entry! Didn't we tell you to stay in the command room at night?!", "Uh, the problem is it's against dorm regulations ...", "Tch ... alright, I'll have a room prepared for you on the third floor. You can stay there. Oh, and don't leave the dorm by yourself, okay?", "Ugh, I'm tired ... I have practice this morning, so I gotta go.", 'I want to tell you something ... in private.', 'Oh, nevermind.', "Y-you might have forgotten about it already, but at Yakushima ... Won't you going to school create more problems?", 'Sorry, Koro-chan ... you have to stay here.', "That idiot ... he knows tonight's the night!", "They what?! So ... it's underneath this whole area?!", 'Fuuka ...', 'In here?!', "That's no surprise ...", "Uh ... sorry. He wouldn't stop bugging me about this place.", "... I doubt it. The archery range is outside, so it's most likely canceled until the storm blows over.", 'Assuming they come out one at a time ... just kidding!', 'Are you serious?! Me and my big mouth ...', "Wait, Ken-kun isn't here, either. Hey Junpei, go get him. That'll be your punishment for last time.", "This is the way we go to school! You used both me and my father!', 'What is this?!', "I just can't believe all this ...", "That sounds rough ... I hope she'll be okay.", "I see ... but still, what are we going to do? Are you listening, Dad? I'm doing okay. I bet you have your hands full, since it's for both juniors and seniors.", "You're not thinking of skipping the trip, are you?", "You can't do that!", "To tell you the truth, you're not the easiest person to relate to. I don\'t like the sound of that.', 'It IS an expensive area, after all.', "Keep dreamin', Junpei ...", "That's not true ...", "You said you were atoning for what the Kirijo Group did in the past, but that's not true. I couldn't stand to see her acting like that, so I used to come out here to the river bank to get away. My belief in my dad was all I had ...", "Yes, but it was still wrong, so he fought to the end to try and make it right again. he never gave up. Title: Persona 3
Dialogues: ['You\'re a junior, right? Since we\'re the same year, you can just call me "Yuko".', "I'll make sure your uniform is ready for next time.", "Why don't we stop somewhere along the way?", '"Where\'s my towel?" "Can you wash this for me?" ... I\'m not their mother. At least I don\'t have to worry about gaining weight, since I\'m always running around and taking care of them. How about you, Minato-kun? Are you enjoying Track Team?', "I thought it might be boring for you, since you're so much better than everyone else ... you've got your own style ... you don't waste much energy. If you have any questions, just ask Kaz ... um, y'know, Kazushi. You guys are in the same class, so I'm sure he'd be willing to help you.", 'But seriously, I have been feeling kind of down lately ... Mr. Ekoda wanted to speak with me. He wanted to know why I turned in a blank quiz.', "Who cares about Classic Literature anyway?! Besides, I didn't do anything wrong! Right, Minato-kun?!", "Doesn't he realize we're only teenagers?! Now's the time to enjoy life! Who cares about stories by a bunch of dead guys?! Maybe I should be a science major. Then I wouldn't have to take Classic Literature ... wait! Then I'd have to take Physics!", 'My reputation as an "intellectual" would be ruined!', "I didn't mean to trick you! ... Is my nose getting longer? You're so gullible ... you shouldn't believe everything people say.", "Three pages?! Is he serious?! What does he expect me to say?! But I guess I have no choice if I want to graduate. Otherwise I'll have to repeat his class. I can't wait to celebrate graduation with everyone, especially the team ... and you too, Minato-kun. Or am I getting ahead of myself?", "Even though I eat lunch everyday, I still get hungry after practice. I consider this an early dinner ... I'll still eat dinner when I get home, though. I really have to stop eating between meals, or I'll gain tons of weight once I'm not so busy with the team. Hey Minato-kun, do you think I eat too much?", 'You live in the dorm, right Minato-kun? Not to pry, but ... you must love being around good-looking girls like Mitsuru and Yukari ...', "If I bump into her a few years from now at the Paulownia Mall, I'll tell her then.", "... I've decided! I'm gonna stop eating between meals! My first goal is to tone up my arms! Did you hear that, Minato-kun? You're my witness.", "Can you hang on a sec? I'll finish the story after I put my shoes on.", 'How childish ...', "It's the same stupid prank again ...", "It wouldn't be funny if I had gum all over my shoes. After the first few times this happened, I stopped counting ... I was pissed off at first, but then I just got used to it. I'm tired of being angry, and I'm just too lazy to do anything about it. But if I catch her in the act, I'll grab her and slap her.", 'Like I thought, brains are just as important as brawn.', "No, we're not dating. Did I say something to offend you?", 'Maybe I should tell you the whole story ... that girl with the black socks, she went to the same middle school as me. Back then, there was this boy on the basketball team who asked me out, and we started dating. But he was seeing her at the same time!', 'She blamed me because I was the manager of the basketball team. Does that make any sense at all? That gum on my shelf ... it was probably her. You know, if people see us sitting together like this, they may think we really ARE dating ...", 'You probably figured that out already, huh? S-see ya later ...', "You know about the club at Paulownia Mall, right? I heard there's a monk who goes there. He even drinks and picks fights! I can't believe a monk would do something like that ... that's what I heard, at least.", "Oh yeah ... here, take this, Minato-kun. It's my special drink. If you use it, you won't be tired anymore.", 'But ...', 'That kid lives across the street from me.', 'This is no place to be playing tag. It was okay this time, since it was me, but what if you had bumped into a stranger? Go play at the playground.', 'Alright, come with me.', 'If you see any strangers, run away. I'm gonna have a look around.", "Pump your arms more and don't lift your legs so high, or you might pull a muscle. Give it a try! I'll be lonely coaching them all by myself ...", "Don't give in to fear!", "The winner will get to use the playground.
